title_en: OmniAID: Decoupling Semantic and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
title_zh: OmniAID：解耦语义与伪影以实现通用 AI 生成图像野外检测

sentences.en: A truly universal AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detector must simultaneously generalize across diverse generative models and varied semantic content.
sentences.zh: 真正通用的 AI 生成图像（AIGI）检测器必须同时泛化到多种多样的生成模型和不同的语义内容。

sentences.en: Current methods learn a single, entangled forgery representation, conflating content-dependent flaws with content-agnostic artifacts, and are further constrained by outdated benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 现有方法学习单一的、纠缠的伪造表示，将依赖于内容的缺陷与不依赖于内容的伪影混为一谈，并且进一步受限于过时的基准。

sentences.en: We propose OmniAID, a novel framework centered on a decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that separates: (1) semantic flaws across distinct content domains via Routable Specialized Semantic Experts, and (2) content-agnostic universal artifacts from content-dependent flaws via a Fixed Universal Artifact Expert.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 OmniAID，一个以解耦的专家混合（MoE）架构为核心的新颖框架，它实现了两类分离：(1) 通过可路由的专门语义专家分离不同内容领域的语义缺陷；(2) 通过固定的通用伪影专家将内容无关的通用伪影与内容相关的缺陷分离开来。

sentences.en: A two-stage training strategy first specializes experts independently with domain-specific hard-sampling, then trains a lightweight gating network for effective input routing.
sentences.zh: 两阶段训练策略首先通过特定领域的困难采样分别专门化各个专家，然后训练一个轻量级门控网络以实现有效的输入路由。

sentences.en: By explicitly decoupling  "what is generated'' (content-specific flaws) from "how it is generated'' (universal artifacts), OmniAID achieves robust generalization.
sentences.zh: 通过明确解耦“生成的是什么”（内容特定的缺陷）与“如何生成的”（通用伪影），OmniAID 实现了稳健的泛化。

sentences.en: We also introduce Mirage, a large-scale, contemporary dataset comprising a modern training set and a challenging test set.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入了 Mirage，一个大规模、当代的数据集，包含现代化的训练集和具有挑战性的测试集。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniAID surpasses existing detectors, establishing a new standard for AIGI detection against modern, in-the-wild threats.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，OmniAID 超越了现有的检测器，为应对现代现实世界威胁的 AIGI 检测树立了新标准。

title_en: OmniFit: Bridging Modalities via Layer-Adaptive Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: OmniFit：通过层自适应词元压缩为全模态大语言模型桥接各模态

sentences.en: Emerging Omni-modal Large Language Models (OmniLLMs) enable real-time interaction across video, audio, and text but suffer from prohibitive computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of processing continuous streaming inputs.
sentences.zh: 新兴的全模态大语言模型（OmniLLMs）支持跨视频、音频和文本的实时交互，但由于处理连续流式输入的二次复杂度，面临高昂的计算成本。

sentences.en: Existing token compression strategies remain suboptimal as they typically rely on biased modality-centric priors or enforce uniform retention policies, neglecting the heterogeneity across layers and the critical role of cross-modality alignment.
sentences.zh: 现有词元压缩策略仍非最优，因为它们通常依赖有偏的以模态为中心的先验，或强制使用统一的保留策略，忽视了跨层的异质性以及跨模态对齐的关键作用。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose OmniFit, a training-free framework that decouples interaction profiling from inference execution.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 OmniFit，一个将交互画像与推理执行解耦的免训练框架。

sentences.en: OmniFit incorporates Layer-Adaptive Heterogeneity Profiling (LAHP) to dynamically allocate computational budgets based on layer-wise redundancy and modality preferences, preserving tokens according to the characteristics of each layer.
sentences.zh: OmniFit 融入了层自适应异质性画像（LAHP），根据逐层冗余和模态偏好动态分配计算预算，并按照每一层的特性保留词元。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce Alignment-Rectified Token Selection (ARTS), a lightweight mechanism that efficiently identifies tokens semantically aligned with cross-modal cues.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了对齐校正词元选择（ARTS），一种能够高效识别与跨模态线索语义对齐的词元的轻量机制。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 3 model series across 10 benchmarks demonstrate that OmniFit establishes a new Pareto frontier, retaining 98\% of model performance with only 20\% token usage and achieves up to 2.31$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and 2.5$\times$ VRAM saving, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在跨 10 个基准的 3 个模型系列上进行的大量实验表明，OmniFit 建立了新的帕累托前沿：仅使用 20\% 的词元用量即可保留 98\% 的模型性能，并实现高达 2.31$\times$ 的端到端推理加速和 2.5$\times$ 的显存节省，显著优于最先进的方法。

title_en: OmniMoE: An Efficient MoE by Orchestrating Atomic Experts at Scale
title_zh: OmniMoE：大规模编排原子专家的高效专家混合模型

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are evolving towards finer granularity to improve parameter efficiency.
sentences.zh: 专家混合（MoE）架构正朝着更细粒度演进，以提升参数效率。

sentences.en: However, existing MoE designs face an inherent trade-off between the granularity of expert specialization and hardware execution efficiency.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 MoE 设计在专家专门化的粒度与硬件执行效率之间面临固有的权衡。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose OmniMoE, a system-algorithm co-designed MoE framework that pushes granularity to the extreme with vector-level Atomic Experts, orchestrating their routing and execution at scale within a single MoE layer, while retaining a shared dense MLP for general-purpose processing.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 OmniMoE，一个系统与算法协同设计的 MoE 框架，它通过向量级原子专家将粒度推向极致，在单个 MoE 层内大规模编排这些专家的路由与执行，同时保留共享的稠密 MLP 用于通用处理。

sentences.en: While this atomic design maximizes capacity, it poses severe challenges for routing complexity and memory access.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种原子设计最大化了容量，但它给路由复杂度和内存访问带来了严峻挑战。

sentences.en: To address these, OmniMoE adopts a system-algorithm co-design: (i) a Cartesian Product Router that decomposes the massive index space to reduce routing complexity from $O(N)$ to $O(\sqrt{N})$; and (ii) Expert-Centric Scheduling that inverts the execution order to turn scattered, memory-bound lookups into efficient dense matrix operations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，OmniMoE 采用了系统与算法协同设计：(i) 笛卡尔积路由器（Cartesian Product Router）分解庞大的索引空间，将路由复杂度从 $O(N)$ 降至 $O(\sqrt{N})$；(ii) 专家中心调度（Expert-Centric Scheduling）颠倒执行顺序，将分散且受内存限制的查找转化为高效的稠密矩阵运算。

sentences.en: Validated on seven benchmarks, OmniMoE (with 1.7B active parameters) achieves 50.9\% zero-shot accuracy across seven benchmarks, outperforming coarse-grained (e.g., DeepSeekMoE) and fine-grained (e.g., PEER) baselines.
sentences.zh: 在七个基准上验证，OmniMoE（具有 1.7B 激活参数）在七个基准上取得了 50.9\% 的零样本准确率，优于粗粒度（如 DeepSeekMoE）和细粒度（如 PEER）的基线方法。

sentences.en: Crucially, OmniMoE reduces inference latency from 73ms to 6.7ms (a 10.9$\times$ speedup) compared to PEER, demonstrating that massive-scale fine-grained MoE can be fast and accurate.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，与 PEER 相比，OmniMoE 将推理延迟从 73ms 降低到 6.7ms（实现了 10.9$\times$ 的加速），证明了大规模细粒度 MoE 可以兼具速度与准确性。

title_en: OmniSapiens: A Foundation Model for Social Behavior Processing via Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization
title_zh: OmniSapiens：通过异质性感知的相对策略优化进行社会行为处理的基础模型

sentences.en: Socially intelligent AI systems must reason across diverse human behavioral tasks and generalize to new social contexts.
sentences.zh: 具社交智能的 AI 系统必须在多种多样的人类行为任务上进行推理，并泛化到新的社交情境。

sentences.en: However, behavioral data is inherently heterogeneous, comprising diverse modalities and prediction targets that produce uneven training signals across samples, creating imbalanced learning dynamics that challenge existing AI models.
sentences.zh: 然而，行为数据本质上是异质的，包含多样的模态和预测目标，会在不同样本间产生不均衡的训练信号，从而造成不平衡的学习动态，对现有的 AI 模型构成挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we develop OmniSapiens-7B 2.0, a foundation model for social behavior processing that explicitly addresses learning from heterogeneous behavioral data.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们开发了 OmniSapiens-7B 2.0，一个用于社会行为处理的基础模型，明确针对从异质行为数据中学习的问题。

sentences.en: This is enabled through Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization, a new RL method that rebalances learning signals across samples by approximating each sample’s contribution to the policy update and using these estimates to drive geometrically centered, inertially smoothed advantage modulation for stable training.
sentences.zh: 这一目标的实现依托于异质性感知的相对策略优化，这是一种新的强化学习方法，通过近似每个样本对策略更新的贡献来重新平衡样本间的学习信号，并利用这些估计驱动几何居中、惯性平滑的优势调制，从而实现稳定训练。

sentences.en: OmniSapiens-7B 2.0 achieves the best and most consistent performance across 10 behavioral tasks, while also attaining the best performance on all five held-out benchmarks, with gains of up to +12.02% and +9.37% respectively.
sentences.zh: OmniSapiens-7B 2.0 在 10 个行为任务上取得了最好且最一致的性能，同时在全部五个留出基准上也取得了最佳性能，分别获得高达 +12.02% 和 +9.37% 的提升。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it demonstrates more consistent and interpretable reasoning traces, supporting reliable real-world behavioral applications.
sentences.zh: 此外，它展现出更一致且可解释的推理轨迹，为可靠的真实世界行为应用提供支撑。

sentences.en: Our model is available at https://github.com/MIT-MI/human_behavior_atlas.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型可在 https://github.com/MIT-MI/human_behavior_atlas 获取。

title_en: OmniShow: Unifying Multimodal Conditions for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
title_zh: OmniShow：统一多模态条件以实现人-物交互视频生成

sentences.en: In this work, we study **Human-Object Interaction Video Generation (HOIVG)**, which aims to synthesize high-quality human-object interaction videos conditioned on text, reference images, audio, and pose.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究 **人-物交互视频生成（HOIVG）**，其目标是合成以文本、参考图像、音频和姿态为条件的高质量人-物交互视频。

sentences.en: We present **OmniShow**, the first all-in-one model tailored for this practical yet challenging task, capable of harmonizing multimodal conditions and delivering industry-grade performance.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **OmniShow**，这是首个针对这一实用而富有挑战性任务定制的一体化模型，能够协调多种多模态条件并提供工业级性能。

sentences.en: To overcome the trade-off between controllability and quality, we introduce **Unified Channel-wise Conditioning** for efficient image and pose injection, and **Gated Local-Context Attention** to ensure precise audio-visual synchronization.
sentences.zh: 为克服可控性与质量之间的权衡，我们引入了用于高效图像和姿态注入的**统一通道式条件控制**，以及用于确保精确音视频同步的**门控局部上下文注意力**。

sentences.en: To effectively address data scarcity, we develop a **Decoupled-Then-Joint Training** strategy that leverages a multi-stage training process with model merging to efficiently harness heterogeneous sub-task datasets.
sentences.zh: 为有效应对数据稀缺问题，我们开发了**先解耦后联合训练**策略，利用带模型合并的多阶段训练过程，高效利用异质子任务数据集。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to fill the evaluation gap in this field, we establish HOIVG-Bench, a dedicated and comprehensive benchmark for HOIVG.
sentences.zh: 此外，为填补该领域的评估空白，我们建立了 HOIVG-Bench，一个专门且全面的 HOIVG 基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniShow achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across various multimodal conditioning settings, setting a solid standard for the emerging HOIVG task.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，OmniShow 在多种多模态条件设置下整体取得了最先进的性能，为新兴的 HOIVG 任务树立了坚实标准。

title_en: OmniSIFT: Modality-Asymmetric Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
title_zh: OmniSIFT：面向高效全模态大语言模型的模态非对称词元压缩

sentences.en: Omni-modal Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in audio-video understanding tasks.
sentences.zh: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLMs）在音视频理解任务中展现了强大的能力。

sentences.en: However, their reliance on long multimodal token sequences leads to substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对长多模态词元序列的依赖导致了可观的计算开销。

sentences.en: Despite this challenge, token compression methods designed for Omni-LLMs remain limited.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在这一挑战，专为 Omni-LLMs 设计的词元压缩方法仍然有限。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose OmniSIFT (Omni-modal Spatio-temporal Informed Fine-grained Token compression), a modality-asymmetric token compression framework tailored for Omni-LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 OmniSIFT（全模态时空感知的细粒度词元压缩），一个专为 Omni-LLMs 定制的模态非对称词元压缩框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, OmniSIFT adopts a two-stage compression strategy: (i) a spatio-temporal video pruning module that removes video redundancy arising from both intra-frame structure and inter-frame overlap, and (ii) a vision-guided audio selection module that filters audio tokens.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，OmniSIFT 采用两阶段压缩策略：(i) 时空视频剪枝模块，移除由帧内结构与帧间重叠产生的视频冗余；(ii) 视觉引导的音频选择模块，用于过滤音频词元。

sentences.en: The entire framework is optimized end-to-end via a differentiable straight-through estimator.
sentences.zh: 整个框架通过可微的直接估计器进行端到端优化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five representative benchmarks verify the efficacy and robustness of OmniSIFT.
sentences.zh: 在五个代表性基准上进行的大量实验验证了 OmniSIFT 的有效性与稳健性。

sentences.en: Notably, for Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniSIFT adds 4.85M parameters while still achieving lower latency than training-free baselines such as OmniZip.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，对于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B，OmniSIFT 仅增加 4.85M 参数，同时仍实现比 OmniZip 等免训练基线更低的延迟。

sentences.en: With only 25% of the original token context, OmniSIFT consistently outperforms all compression baselines and even surpasses the full-token model on several tasks.
sentences.zh: 仅使用原始词元上下文的 25%，OmniSIFT 就稳定地优于所有压缩基线，甚至在多个任务上超越了全词元模型。

title_en: OmniVideo-R1: Reinforcing Audio-visual Reasoning with Query Intention and Modality Attention
title_zh: OmniVideo-R1：利用查询意图与模态注意力强化音视频推理

sentences.en: While humans perceive the world through diverse modalities that operate synergistically to support a holistic understanding of their surroundings, existing omnivideo models still face substantial challenges on audio-visual understanding tasks.
sentences.zh: 虽然人类通过多种协同运作的模态感知世界，以支持对周围环境的整体理解，但现有的全视频（omnivideo）模型在音视频理解任务上仍面临重大挑战。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose OmniVideo-R1, a novel reinforced framework that improves mixed-modality reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 OmniVideo-R1，一个改进混合模态推理的新型强化框架。

sentences.en: OmniVideo-R1 empowers models to "think with omnimodal cues" by two key strategies: (1) query‑intensive grounding based on self‑supervised learning paradigms; and (2) modality‑attentive fusion built upon contrastive learning paradigms.
sentences.zh: OmniVideo-R1 通过两大关键策略使模型能够“利用全模态线索进行思考”：(1) 基于自监督学习范式的查询密集型接地（grounding）；(2) 建立在对比学习范式之上的模态注意力融合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OmniVideo-R1 consistently outperforms strong baselines, highlighting its effectiveness and robust generalization capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上进行的大量实验表明，OmniVideo-R1 始终优于强大的基线，凸显了其有效性和稳健的泛化能力。

title_en: OmniVL-Guard: Towards Unified Vision-Language Forgery Detection and Grounding via Balanced RL
title_zh: OmniVL-Guard：经由均衡 RL 实现统一的视觉-语言伪造检测与定位

sentences.en: Existing forgery detection methods are often limited to uni-modal or bi-modal settings, failing to handle the interleaved text, images, and videos prevalent in real-world misinformation.
sentences.zh: 现有的伪造检测方法往往局限于单模态或双模态设定，无法处理现实世界虚假信息中常见的交错出现的文本、图像和视频。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose **OmniVL-Guard**, a unified framework for omni vision-language forgery detection and grounding.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 **OmniVL-Guard**，一个用于全视觉-语言伪造检测与定位的统一框架。

sentences.en: In this unified setting, the interplay between diverse modalities and the dual requirements of simultaneous detection and localization pose significant optimization challenges.
sentences.zh: 在这种统一设定下，不同模态之间的相互作用，以及同时进行检测与定位的双重要求，带来了显著的优化挑战。

sentences.en: Through extensive investigations, we identify a critical difficulty bias in this multi-task optimization: the simpler veracity classification task tends to dominate the gradients, leading to suboptimal performance in fine-grained grounding.
sentences.zh: 通过大量研究，我们在这种多任务优化中发现了一个关键难度偏差：较简单的真实性分类任务往往主导梯度，导致细粒度定位性能欠佳。

sentences.en: To address this imbalance, we first develop a Self-Evolving CoT Generation pipeline to synthesize high-quality reasoning paths, effectively overcoming the cold-start challenge.
sentences.zh: 为应对这种不平衡，我们首先开发了自进化 CoT 生成流水线，用于合成高质量的推理路径，有效克服冷启动挑战。

sentences.en: Building upon this, we propose **A**daptive **R**eward **S**caling **P**olicy **O**ptimization (**ARSPO**).
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出了自适应奖励缩放策略优化（**A**daptive **R**eward **S**caling **P**olicy **O**ptimization，**ARSPO**）。

sentences.en: By dynamically modulating reward scales and task weights, ARSPO ensures a balanced joint optimization that prioritizes challenging grounding objectives.
sentences.zh: 通过动态调节奖励缩放与任务权重，ARSPO 确保了优先关注有挑战性的定位目标的均衡联合优化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniVL-Guard significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits robust zero-shot generalization across out-of-domain scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，OmniVL-Guard 显著优于最先进的方法，并在跨域场景中展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。

title_en: OMP: One-step Meanflow Policy with Directional Alignment
title_zh: OMP：具有方向对齐的一步均值流策略

sentences.en: Robot manipulation has increasingly adopted data-driven generative policy frameworks, yet the field faces a persistent trade-off: diffusion models suffer from high inference latency, while flow-based methods often require complex architectural constraints.
sentences.zh: 机器人操控日益采用数据驱动的生成式策略框架，但该领域面对一个持续存在的权衡：扩散模型存在推理延迟高的问题，而基于流的方法往往需要复杂的架构约束。

sentences.en: Although in image generation domain, the MeanFlow paradigm offers a path to single-step inference, its direct application to robotics is impeded by critical theoretical pathologies, specifically spectral bias and gradient starvation in low-velocity regimes.
sentences.zh: 尽管在图像生成领域，MeanFlow 范式为单步推理提供了一条路径，但其在机器人领域的直接应用受到关键理论缺陷的阻碍，特别是在低速状态下的谱偏差和梯度饥饿。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose the One-step MeanFlow Policy (OMP), a novel framework designed for high-fidelity, real-time manipulation.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出了单步均值流策略（OMP），一个专为高保真、实时操控设计的新颖框架。

sentences.en: We introduce a lightweight directional alignment mechanism to explicitly synchronize predicted velocities with true mean velocities.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种轻量的方向对齐机制，以显式地将预测速度与真实平均速度同步。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we implement a Differential Derivation Equation (DDE) to approximate the Jacobian-Vector Product (JVP) operator, which decouples forward and backward passes to significantly reduce memory complexity.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们实现了微分推导方程（DDE）来近似雅可比-向量积（JVP）算子，它将前向与反向传播解耦，从而显著降低内存复杂度。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the Adroit and Meta-World benchmarks demonstrate that OMP outperforms state-of-the-art methods in success rate and trajectory accuracy, particularly in high-precision tasks, while retaining the efficiency of single-step generation.
sentences.zh: 在 Adroit 和 Meta-World 基准上进行的大量实验表明，OMP 在成功率和轨迹精度上优于最先进的方法，尤其是在高精度任务中，同时保留了单步生成的效率。

title_en: On Computation and Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 论计算与强化学习

sentences.en: How does the amount of compute available to a reinforcement learning (RL) policy affect its learning?
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）策略可用的计算量如何影响其学习？

sentences.en: Can policies using a fixed amount of parameters, still benefit from additional compute?
sentences.zh: 使用固定参数量的策略能否仍然从额外的计算中获益？

sentences.en: The standard RL framework does not provide a language to answer these questions formally.
sentences.zh: 标准的 RL 框架并未提供一种语言来正式地回答这些问题。

sentences.en: Empirically, deep RL policies are often parameterized as neural networks with static architectures, conflating the amount of compute and the number of parameters.
sentences.zh: 从经验上看，深度 RL 策略通常被参数化为具有静态架构的神经网络，从而将计算量与参数数量混为一谈。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formalize compute bounded policies and prove that policies which use more compute can solve problems and generalize to longer-horizon tasks that are outside the scope of policies with less compute.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们形式化了受计算约束的策略，并证明使用更多计算的策略能够解决那些计算较少的策略所无法胜任的问题，并泛化到更长范围的任务。

sentences.en: Building on prior work in algorithmic learning and model-free planning, we propose a minimal architecture that can use a variable amount of compute.
sentences.zh: 基于算法学习与无模型规划方面的先前工作，我们提出了一种可以使用可变计算量的极简架构。

sentences.en: Our experiments complement our theory.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验对理论形成了补充。

sentences.en: On a set 31 different tasks spanning online and offline RL, we show that $(1)$ this architecture achieves stronger performance simply by using more compute, and $(2)$ stronger generalization on longer-horizon test tasks compared to standard feedforward networks or deep residual network using upto 5 times more parameters.
sentences.zh: 在涵盖在线与离线 RL 的 31 个不同任务上，我们表明：$(1)$ 该架构仅通过使用更多计算即可取得更强的性能；$(2)$ 与标准前馈网络或使用多达 5 倍参数的深度残差网络相比，在更长范围的测试任务上具有更强的泛化能力。

title_en: On Contraction of Sequential and Offset Rademacher Complexities
title_zh: 关于序贯与偏移 Rademacher 复杂度的收缩

sentences.en: The Rademacher complexity of a function class is among the most basic notions of its ``size'' and yields classical offline generalization bounds for Lipschitz loss functions that lead in turn to a modern understanding of statistical learning.
sentences.zh: 函数类的 Rademacher 复杂度是其“大小”最基本的度量概念之一，它给出了 Lipschitz 损失函数的经典离线泛化界，进而带来了对统计学习的现代理解。

sentences.en: More recently, the *sequential* and *offset* Rademacher complexities were introduced to prove analogous generalization bounds for online learning and for prediction with squared loss.
sentences.zh: 近年来，人们引入了*序贯*与*偏移* Rademacher 复杂度，用于证明在线学习以及平方损失预测的类似泛化界。

sentences.en: A fundamental structural result in the theory of Rademacher complexity, with many applications to learning theory, is the Ledoux--Talagrand contraction lemma, which states that the Rademacher complexity of a composition of a function class with a fixed Lipschitz function is at most that of the original class.
sentences.zh: Rademacher 复杂度理论中一个具有许多学习理论应用的基本结构性结论是 Ledoux--Talagrand 收缩引理，它指出：函数类与固定 Lipschitz 函数复合后的 Rademacher 复杂度至多等于原函数类的复杂度。

sentences.en: We show that, under structural assumptions on the function class, this contraction extends to sequential and offset Rademacher complexity at the price of polylogarithmic factors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在函数类的结构性假设下，这种收缩可以推广到序贯与偏移 Rademacher 复杂度，代价是多对数因子。

sentences.en: We further show that these logarithmic factors cannot be removed in general and, absent these additional structural assumptions, no such contraction inequality can hold.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，一般而言这些对数因子无法被移除，并且在没有这些额外结构性假设的情况下，任何此类收缩不等式都无法成立。

sentences.en: These results together indicate that the sequential and offset Rademacher complexities behave fundamentally differently from the classical Rademacher complexity with respect to contraction, which in turn has broad implications for understanding the sample complexities of online learning and regression with squared loss for composed function classes.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同表明，序贯与偏移 Rademacher 复杂度在收缩行为上与经典 Rademacher 复杂度有着根本性的不同，这反过来对于理解复合函数类下在线学习与平方损失回归的样本复杂度具有广泛的意义。

title_en: On Densest $k$-Subgraph Mining and Diagonal Loading: Optimization Landscape and Finite-Step Exact Convergence Analysis
title_zh: 关于最稠密 $k$-子图挖掘与对角加载：优化景观与有限步精确收敛分析

sentences.en: The Densest $k$-Subgraph (D$k$S) is a fundamental combinatorial problem known for its theoretical hardness and breadth of  applications.
sentences.zh: 最稠密 $k$-子图（D$k$S）问题是一个基本的组合优化问题，以其理论难度和广泛的应用而闻名。

sentences.en: Recently, Lu et al. (AAAI 2025) introduced a penalty-based non-convex relaxation that achieves promising empirical performance; however, a rigorous theoretical understanding of its success remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 近期，Lu 等人（AAAI 2025）提出了一种基于惩罚的非凸松弛方法，取得了很有前景的实证性能；然而，对其成功原因的严格理论理解仍不清晰。

sentences.en: In this work, we bridge this gap by providing a comprehensive theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过提供全面的理论分析来填补这一空白。

sentences.en: We first establish the tightness of the relaxation, ensuring that the global maximum values of the original combinatorial problem and the relaxed problem coincide.
sentences.zh: 我们首先确立了该松弛的紧致性，确保原始组合问题与松弛问题的全局最大值一致。

sentences.en: Then we reveal the benign geometry of the optimization landscape by proving a strict dichotomy of stationary points: all integral stationary points are local maximizers, whereas all non-integral stationary points are strict saddles with explicit positive curvature.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们通过证明驻点的严格二分性来揭示优化景观的良好几何结构：所有整数驻点都是局部极大点，而所有非整数驻点都是具有显式正曲率的严格鞍点。

sentences.en: We propose a saddle-escaping Frank--Wolfe algorithm and prove that it achieves exact convergence to an integral local maximizer in a finite number of steps.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种逃离鞍点的 Frank--Wolfe 算法，并证明它能在有限步内精确收敛到整数局部极大点。

title_en: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
title_zh: 关于智能体式工具调用与 RL 训练的有效性与效率

sentences.en: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge.
sentences.zh: 工具调用是现代大语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心组成部分，赋予它们超越参数化知识的技能。

sentences.en: This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: **effectiveness**, i.e., how this capability is *measured*, and **efficiency**, i.e., how it is *learned*.
sentences.zh: 本文沿两条互补的轴线研究工具调用：**有效性**，即这一能力如何被*度量*；以及**效率**，即它如何被*习得*。

sentences.en: On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the *random seed*, *system prompt*, *multi-turn template construction*, and how *prior interaction/reasoning history* is carried forward.
sentences.zh: 在有效性方面，我们系统地分析了工具调用评估流水线，并表明结果对看似微小、往往未被文档化的实现选择高度敏感，这些选择包括*随机种子*、*系统提示词*、*多轮模板构建*，以及*先前交互/推理历史*如何被传递。

sentences.en: These choices can lead to substantial differences in reported performance, especially in multi-turn settings where without rigorous standardization, leaderboard rankings are unreliable.
sentences.zh: 这些选择可能导致报告性能出现显著差异，尤其是在多轮设定中，若缺乏严格标准化，排行榜排名将不可靠。

sentences.en: On efficiency, we examine standard reinforcement learning (RL) for tool-calling and identify two sources of computational waste: (i) during rollouts, many prompts produce no learning signal, and (ii) during policy updates, optimization incurs high computational cost.
sentences.zh: 在效率方面，我们考察了用于工具调用的标准强化学习（RL），并指出了两个计算浪费的来源：(i) 在 rollout 期间，许多提示词不产生学习信号；(ii) 在策略更新期间，优化过程带来高昂的计算成本。

sentences.en: Guided by these findings, we introduce two techniques that accelerate RL-based tool-calling training, achieving substantial wall-clock speedup without degrading performance.
sentences.zh: 在这些发现的指导下，我们引入了两种加速基于 RL 的工具调用训练的技术，在不降低性能的情况下实现了显著的墙钟时间加速。

title_en: On Efficient Scaling of GNNs via IO-Aware Layers Implementations
title_zh: 通过 I/O 感知的层实现实现 GNN 的高效扩展

sentences.en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are bottlenecked by sparse, irregular memory access.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNNs）的性能瓶颈在于稀疏、不规则的内存访问。

sentences.en: Popular frameworks such as DGL and PyTorch Geometric support general message passing, but complex layers often materialize edge-wise intermediates, increasing memory traffic and limiting scalability on large graphs.
sentences.zh: DGL 和 PyTorch Geometric 等流行框架支持通用的消息传递，但复杂层往往物化出逐边的中间结果，增加了内存流量并限制了大图上的可扩展性。

sentences.en: We take an I/O- and arithmetic-intensity--centric view and show that widely used layers fall into three kernel families: SpMM-based convolutions, reduction-based aggregations, and attention-based layers (GATv2/Graph Transformer).
sentences.zh: 我们采取以 I/O 和运算强度为中心的视角，并表明广泛使用的层可以归入三类核家族：基于 SpMM 的卷积、基于归约的聚合，以及基于注意力的层（GATv2/Graph Transformer）。

sentences.en: For each family, we develop GPU kernels that reduce data movement, improve locality, and remain robust across realistic graphs.
sentences.zh: 针对每一类，我们开发了减少数据移动、改善局部性，并在现实图上保持稳健的 GPU 核。

sentences.en: We also study graph reordering and find that its impact depends on the kernel mapping: it benefits neighbor-parallel (gather-dominated) kernels more consistently than feature-parallel designs.
sentences.zh: 我们还研究了图重排，发现其影响取决于核映射方式：它对邻居并行（以收集为主）核的收益比特征并行设计更为稳定。

sentences.en: Empirically, our fused attention kernels reach up to **3.9**$\times$ speedup for Graph Transformer (median **1.6**$\times$), with Tensor Core (block-sparse) variants up to **7.3**$\times$ on locally dense graphs; for GATv2 we reach up to **8.5**$\times$ speedup (median **2.0**$\times$) while reducing peak memory by up to **76**$\times$ (median **6**$\times$).
sentences.zh: 实证上，我们的融合注意力核为 Graph Transformer 实现了高达 **3.9**$\times$ 的加速（中位数 **1.6**$\times$），其中 Tensor Core（块稀疏）变体在局部稠密图上可达 **7.3**$\times$；对于 GATv2，我们实现了高达 **8.5**$\times$ 的加速（中位数 **2.0**$\times$），同时将峰值内存最多减少 **76**$\times$（中位数 **6**$\times$）。

sentences.en: Our degree-aware reduction kernels achieve up to **10**$\times$ speedup (median **2.6**$\times$).
sentences.zh: 我们的度感知归约核实现了高达 **10**$\times$ 的加速（中位数 **2.6**$\times$）。

sentences.en: For SpMM-based layers, properly cached cuSPARSE achieves up to **8**$\times$ speedup over DGL and outperforms evaluated custom baselines in the majority of evaluations.
sentences.zh: 对于基于 SpMM 的层，合理缓存的 cuSPARSE 相比 DGL 实现了高达 **8**$\times$ 的加速，并且在大多数评估中优于所评测的自定义基线。

sentences.en: We release our implementations as drop-in replacements to support reproducible, hardware-aware GNN acceleration.
sentences.zh: 我们以即插即用替换组件的形式发布实现，以支持可复现的、感知硬件的 GNN 加速。

title_en: On Expressive Power of Floating-Point Transformers
title_zh: 论浮点 Transformer 的表达能力

sentences.en: Research on the expressive power of transformers shows that transformers are equivariant to permutations and can approximate all permutation-equivariant continuous functions on a compact domain.
sentences.zh: 关于 Transformer 表达能力的研究表明，Transformer 对排列是等变的，并且可以逼近紧凑域上的所有排列等变连续函数。

sentences.en: However, these results assume real parameters and exact operations, whereas real-world implementations on computers can only use a finite set of numbers and inexact machine operations with round-off errors.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些结果假设使用实数参数和精确运算，而计算机上的现实实现只能使用有限集合的数字和带有舍入误差的不精确机器运算。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate the representability of floating-point transformers that use floating-point parameters and floating-point operations.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究了使用浮点参数和浮点运算的浮点 Transformer 的可表示性。

sentences.en: Unlike existing results under exact arithmetic, we first show that floating-point transformers can represent non-permutation-equivariant functions even without positional encoding.
sentences.zh: 与精确算术下已有的结果不同，我们首先表明，即使没有位置编码，浮点 Transformer 也能表示非排列等变函数。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we prove that floating-point transformers can represent all permutation-equivariant functions when the sequence length is bounded, but they cannot when the sequence length is large.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明，当序列长度有界时，浮点 Transformer 可以表示所有排列等变函数，但当序列长度较大时则不能。

sentences.en: We also identify the minimal equivariance property in floating-point transformers, and show that all non-trivial additive positional encoding can harm the representability of floating-point transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们还识别了浮点 Transformer 中的最小等变性质，并表明所有非平凡的加性位置编码都可能损害浮点 Transformer 的可表示性。

title_en: On Group Relative Policy Optimization Collapse in Agent Search: The Lazy Likelihood-Displacement
title_zh: 论智能体搜索中的群体相对策略优化崩溃：惰性似然位移

sentences.en: Tool-integrated (TI) reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to perform multi-step reasoning by interacting with external tools such as search engines and retrievers.
sentences.zh: 工具集成（TI）强化学习（RL）使大语言模型（LLMs）能够通过与搜索引擎、检索器等外部工具交互来进行多步推理。

sentences.en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), exemplified by the recent Search-R1, offers fast convergence and a value-free formulation that makes it appealing for this setting, yet consistently suffers from training collapse.
sentences.zh: 以近期 Search-R1 为代表的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）具有快速收敛和无价值函数（value-free）的公式化形式，使其在这一场景中颇具吸引力，但它却持续遭受训练崩溃问题。

sentences.en: We identify Lazy Likelihood Displacement (LLD), a systematic reduction or stagnation in the likelihood of both correct and incorrect responses, as the core mechanism driving this failure.
sentences.zh: 我们将惰性似然位移（LLD）——正确与错误响应的似然均出现系统性下降或停滞——确认为导致这一失败的核心机制。

sentences.en: LLD emerges early and triggers a self-reinforcing LLD Death Spiral, where declining likelihood leads to low-confidence responses, inflating gradients, and ultimately causing collapse.
sentences.zh: LLD 很早就出现，并触发一种自我强化的 LLD 死亡螺旋：似然下降导致低置信响应，进而放大梯度，最终造成崩溃。

sentences.en: We empirically characterize this process across models on a Search-R1-style, search-integrated question answering task, revealing a consistent three-phase trajectory: early stagnation, steady decay, and accelerated collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个 Search-R1 风格的、集成搜索的问答任务上，跨多个模型对这一过程进行了实证刻画，揭示出一致的三个阶段轨迹：早期停滞、稳定衰减和加速崩溃。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a likelihood-preserving regularization LLDS that activates only when a response action’s likelihood decreases, and regularizes only the tokens responsible.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种保持似然的正则化方法 LLDS，它仅在响应动作的似然下降时激活，并且只对被归因的词元施加正则化。

sentences.en: This fine-grained structure mitigates LLD with minimal interference.
sentences.zh: 这种细粒度结构以最小的干扰缓解了 LLD。

sentences.en: Our method stabilizes training, prevents gradient explosion, and yields substantial performance improvements across seven benchmarks, including relative improvements of +45.2% on Qwen2.5-3B and +37.1% on Qwen2.5-7B over vanilla GRPO training.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法稳定了训练，防止了梯度爆炸，并在七个基准上带来了显著的性能提升，包括在 Qwen2.5-3B 上相对提升 +45.2%、在 Qwen2.5-7B 上相对提升 +37.1%（相对于普通 GRPO 训练）。

sentences.en: Our results establish LLD as a previously overlooked bottleneck in GRPO- based TIRL and provide a practical path toward stable, scalable training of tool-integrated RL.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果确立了 LLD 是 GRPO 式工具集成 RL（TIRL）中一个此前被忽视的瓶颈，并为工具集成 RL 的稳定、可扩展训练提供了一条实用路径。

title_en: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM agents
title_zh: 论LLM智能体主动推理中强化学习的信息自锁现象

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a de facto paradigm for building LLM-based agents that act, interact, and reason over extended task horizons.
sentences.zh: 强化学习(RL)已成为构建基于LLM的智能体的事实范式，这类智能体能够在较长的任务跨度内行动、交互并进行推理。

sentences.en: However, in active reasoning where agents must elicit new observations through interaction with the environment to solve the task, we find that outcome-based RL can induce a systematic failure mode which we call information self-locking (SeL): agents fail both to elicit informative feedback and to internalize obtained evidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，在主动推理场景中，智能体必须通过与环境的交互获得新的观测来解决任务。我们发现，基于结果的RL可能引发一种系统性的失败模式，我们称之为信息自锁(SeL)：智能体既无法引发信息丰富的反馈，也无法将获得的证据内化。

sentences.en: To understand the issue, we trace agentic behaviors into two coupled capabilities: Action Selection (AS), which determines observation streams, and Belief Tracking (BT), which updates the agent’s internal task understanding.
sentences.zh: 为了理解这一问题，我们将智能体的行为追溯为两种耦合的能力：动作选择(AS)，决定观测流；信念跟踪(BT)，更新智能体对任务的内部理解。

sentences.en: Theoretical and empirical analyses reveal a bidirectional bottleneck that leads to SeL: weak BT obscures the credit of informative actions, while weak AS deprives BT of useful evidence.
sentences.zh: 理论与实证分析揭示了一个导致SeL的双向瓶颈：薄弱的BT模糊了信息丰富动作的贡献，而薄弱的AS则剥夺了BT获取有用证据的途径。

sentences.en: This coupling weakens the learning signal for both capabilities and leads to SeL. To mitigate this issue, we propose AREW, a simple yet effective Advantage Reweighting method that uses easy-to-obtain directional critiques to reallocate credit within trajectories.
sentences.zh: 这种耦合削弱了两种能力的学习信号，并导致SeL。为缓解这一问题，我们提出AREW，一种简单而有效的优势重加权方法，利用易于获得的定向批评在轨迹内重新分配贡献。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across 9 agentic tasks of varying complexity show that AREW significantly mitigates SeL, yielding up to 60-point gains in final performance.
sentences.zh: 在9个复杂度各异的智能体任务上的大量实验表明，AREW显著缓解了SeL，最终性能最高提升达60分。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/unimpor/T3.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/unimpor/T3 获取。

authors.name: Deyu Zou
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

title_en: On Learnability and Disambiguation of Multiclass Partial Concept Classes
title_zh: 论多分类部分概念类的可学习性与消歧

sentences.en: We study the Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learnability of partial concept classes in the multiclass setting, where the label space can be infinite.
sentences.zh: 我们研究多分类设置下部分概念类的PAC可学习性，其中标签空间可以是无限的。

sentences.en: While the Natarajan dimension characterizes learnability for finite label spaces, we show it fails when the label space is unbounded.
sentences.zh: 虽然Natarajan维度刻画了有限标签空间的可学习性，但我们在标签空间无界时展示了其失效。

sentences.en: Instead, we prove that the Daniely-Shalev (DS) dimension provides a characterization of learnability for partial concept classes in the general multiclass setting.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们证明在一般多分类设置下，Daniely-Shalev（DS）维度为部分概念类的可学习性提供了刻画。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our analysis reveals a surprising phenomenon we call the ``Disambiguation Paradox'': disambiguation schemes with simple label space can destroy learnability, while richer labeling may preserves it.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的分析揭示了一个我们称之为“消歧悖论”的惊人现象：具有简单标签空间的消歧方案会破坏可学习性，而更丰富的标注可能能保持可学习性。

sentences.en: We further characterize how the number and structure of disambiguation labels control the induced DS dimension, yielding a trade-off between label complexity and sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步刻画了消歧标签的数量和结构如何控制由此产生的DS维度，从而在标签复杂度与样本复杂度之间取得权衡。

title_en: On Minimum Depth and Width of Floating-Point Neural Networks for Representing Floating-Point Functions
title_zh: 表示浮点函数所需的浮点神经网络的最小深度与宽度

sentences.en: Research on the expressive power of neural networks has identified the minimum depth and width of neural networks that enable universal approximation and memorization.
sentences.zh: 关于神经网络表达能力的研究已经确定了能够实现通用逼近和记忆的最小网络深度与宽度。

sentences.en: However, existing results are derived under exact arithmetic and cannot be directly applied to real implementations on computers, which can only use a finite set of numbers and inexact machine operations with round-off errors.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有结果是在精确算术下推导出来的，无法直接应用于计算机上的实际实现，因为计算机只能使用有限集合的数和带舍入误差的不精确机器运算。

sentences.en: In this work, we study floating-point ReLU networks that have floating-point parameters and use floating-point operations.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究具有浮点参数并使用浮点运算的浮点ReLU网络。

sentences.en: Specifically, we investigate their minimum depth and width to represent all functions from the set of floating-point vectors $\mathbb F^d$ to the set of floating-point numbers $\mathbb F$.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们考察它们表示从浮点向量集合 $\mathbb F^d$ 到浮点数集合 $\mathbb F$ 的所有函数所需的最小深度与宽度。

sentences.en: We first show that the minimum depth for representing all functions from $\mathbb F^d$ to $\mathbb F$ is exactly three, where two layers can be sufficient if we consider a smaller domain and/or codomain.
sentences.zh: 我们首先证明表示从 $\mathbb F^d$ 到 $\mathbb F$ 的所有函数所需的最小深度恰好为三层；若考虑更小的定义域和/或值域，则两层就足够了。

sentences.en: We further show that the minimum width for representing all functions from $\mathbb F^d$ to $\mathbb F$ lies between $2d$ and $2d+4$.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明表示从 $\mathbb F^d$ 到 $\mathbb F$ 的所有函数所需的最小宽度介于 $2d$ 与 $2d+4$ 之间。

sentences.en: In addition, if we restrict the domain to non-negative floats, it lies between $d$ and $d+4$, where it can be smaller for a smaller domain, even beyond $d$.
sentences.zh: 此外，若将定义域限制为非负浮点数，则该宽度介于 $d$ 与 $d+4$ 之间；对于更小的定义域，它甚至可以小于 $d$。

sentences.en: Our results show that the existing results analyzed under exact arithmetic do not extend to the floating-point setup.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，在精确算术下分析的现有结果无法推广到浮点设置。

authors.name: Geonho Hwang
authors.institution: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology

title_en: On Path to Multimodal Historical Reasoning: HistBench and HistAgent
title_zh: 通往多模态历史推理之路：HistBench与HistAgent

sentences.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to remarkable progress across various domains, yet their capabilities in the humanities, particularly history, remain underexplored.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展已在各个领域取得了显著的进步，然而它们在人文领域（尤其是历史）的能力仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: Historical reasoning poses unique challenges for LLMs, involving multimodal source interpretation, temporal inference, and cross-linguistic analysis.
sentences.zh: 历史推理对LLMs提出了独特的挑战，涉及多模态资料解读、时间推断和跨语言分析。

sentences.en: Existing general-purpose agents perform well on many current benchmarks but lack the domain expertise needed to address complex historical questions.
sentences.zh: 现有的通用智能体在许多当前基准上表现出色，但缺乏应对复杂历史问题所需的领域专业知识。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce HistBench, a new benchmark of 414 high-quality and carefully-reviewed questions stratified by difficulty and designed to evaluate LLM's capacity for historical reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们引入了HistBench，一个包含414道高质量且经过细致审查的问题的新基准，这些问题按难度分层，旨在评估LLM的历史推理能力。

sentences.en: The tasks span a wide range of historical problems—from factual retrieval based on primary sources to interpretive analysis of manuscripts and images, to interdisciplinary challenges involving archaeology, linguistics, or cultural history.
sentences.zh: 任务涵盖广泛的历史问题——从基于原始文献的事实检索，到对手稿和图像的解读分析，再到涉及考古学、语言学或文化史的跨学科挑战。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the benchmark dataset spans 29 ancient and modern languages and covers a wide range of historical periods and world regions.
sentences.zh: 此外，该基准数据集涵盖29种古代和现代语言，覆盖了广泛的历史时期和世界地区。

sentences.en: Finding the poor performance of LLMs and other agents on HistBench, we further present HistAgent, a history-specific agent equipped with carefully designed tools for OCR, translation, archival search, and image understanding in history.
sentences.zh: 鉴于LLM和其他智能体在HistBench上的糟糕表现，我们进一步提出了HistAgent，一个专用于历史的智能体，配备了精心设计的历史OCR、翻译、档案检索和图像理解工具。

sentences.en: On HistBench, HistAgent based on GPT-4o achieves an accuracy of 28.50\% pass@1 and 36.47\% pass@2, significantly outperforming LLMs with online search and generalist agents, including GPT-4o (18.60\%), DeepSeek-R1 (14.98\%), Grok 3 (17.63\%) and Open Deep Research by smolagents (19.57\% pass@1 and 25.12\% pass@2).
sentences.zh: 在HistBench上，基于GPT-4o的HistAgent实现了28.50\% 的pass@1和36.47\% 的pass@2准确率，显著优于带在线搜索的LLM和通用智能体，包括GPT-4o（18.60\%）、DeepSeek-R1（14.98\%）、Grok 3（17.63\%）以及smolagents的Open Deep Research（19.57\% pass@1和25.12\% pass@2）。

sentences.en: These results highlight the limitations of existing LLMs and generalist agents and demonstrate the advantages of HistAgent for historical reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了现有LLM和通用智能体的局限性，并展示了HistAgent在历史推理方面的优势。

sentences.en: Notably, HistAgent also achieves 60.00\% pass@1 accuracy on the GAIA benchmark, showing that domain-specific customization doesnot hinder HistAgent's competitive performance on real-world general tasks.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，HistAgent在GAIA基准上也达到了60.00\% 的pass@1准确率，表明特定领域的定制并不会阻碍HistAgent在真实通用任务上保持有竞争力的表现。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/CharlesQ9/HistAgent.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/CharlesQ9/HistAgent 获取。

authors.name: Yimin Wang
authors.institution: Shanghai Jiao Tong University & University of Michigan

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: On Regret Bounds of Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization
title_zh: 贝叶斯优化中汤普森采样的遗憾界

sentences.en: We study a widely used Bayesian optimization method, Gaussian process Thompson sampling (GP-TS), under the assumption that the objective function is a sample path from a GP.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一种广泛使用的贝叶斯优化方法——高斯过程汤普森采样（GP-TS），并假设目标函数是GP的一条样本路径。

sentences.en: Compared with the GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) with established high-probability and expected regret bounds, most analyses of GP-TS have been limited to expected regret.
sentences.zh: 与已建立高概率遗憾界和期望遗憾界的GP上置信界（GP-UCB）相比，大多数对GP-TS的分析仅限于期望遗憾。

sentences.en: Moreover, whether the recent analyses of GP-UCB for the lenient regret and the improved cumulative regret upper bound can be applied to GP-TS remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 此外，近期对GP-UCB在宽松遗憾和改进的累积遗憾上界方面的分析是否适用于GP-TS仍不清楚。

sentences.en: To fill these gaps, this paper shows several regret bounds:  (i) a regret lower bound for GP-TS, which implies that GP-TS suffers from a polynomial dependence on $1/\delta$ with probability $\delta$,  (ii) an upper bound of the second moment of cumulative regret, which directly suggests an improved regret upper bound on $\delta$,  (iii) expected lenient regret upper bounds, and  (iv) an improved cumulative regret upper bound on the time horizon $T$.
sentences.zh: 为填补这些空白，本文给出了若干遗憾界：（i）GP-TS的遗憾下界，这意味着GP-TS以概率 $\delta$ 对 $1/\delta$ 存在多项式依赖；（ii）累积遗憾二阶矩的上界，这直接推得关于 $\delta$ 的改进遗憾上界；（iii）期望宽松遗憾上界；以及（iv）关于时间范围 $T$ 的改进累积遗憾上界。

sentences.en: Along the way, we provide several useful lemmas, including a relaxation of the necessary condition from recent analysis to obtain improved regret upper bounds on $T$.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我们提供了若干有用的引理，包括对近期分析中获取关于 $T$ 的改进遗憾上界所需条件的松弛。

title_en: On Revisiting Entropy for Identifying Mislabeled Images
title_zh: 重新审视熵在识别错误标注图像中的应用

sentences.en: Mislabeled samples in training datasets severely degrade the performance of deep networks, as overparameterized models tend to memorize erroneous labels.
sentences.zh: 训练数据集中的错误标注样本会严重降低深度网络的性能，因为过参数化模型往往会记忆错误的标签。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by proposing a novel approach for mislabeled data detection that leverages training dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们通过提出一种利用训练动态进行错误标注数据检测的新方法来应对这一挑战。

sentences.en: Our method is grounded in the key observation that correctly labeled samples exhibit consistent entropy decrease during training, while mislabeled samples maintain relatively high entropy throughout the training process.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法基于一个关键观察：正确标注的样本在训练过程中表现出一致的熵下降，而错误标注的样本在整个训练过程中保持相对较高的熵。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we introduce a signed entropy integral (SEI) statistic that captures both the magnitude and temporal trend of prediction entropy across training epochs.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们引入了带符号熵积分（SEI）统计量，它捕捉了预测熵在训练轮次间的幅度和时间趋势。

sentences.en: SEI is broadly applicable to classification networks and demonstrates particular effectiveness when integrated with contrastive language-image pretraining (CLIP) architectures.
sentences.zh: SEI广泛适用于分类网络，并且在与对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）架构集成时表现出特别的效力。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on four medical imaging datasets---a domain particularly susceptible to labeling errors due to diagnostic complexity---spanning diverse modalities and pathologies, we demonstrate that SEI achieves state-of-the-art performance in mislabeled data identification, outperforming existing methods while maintaining computational efficiency and implementation simplicity.
sentences.zh: 通过在四个医学影像数据集（——这是一个因诊断复杂性而特别容易受到标注错误影响的领域）上涵盖多样模态和病理的大量实验，我们证明SEI在错误标注数据识别上达到了最先进的性能，在保持计算效率和实现简单性的同时优于现有方法。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/MedAITech/SEI.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/MedAITech/SEI 获取。

authors.name: Chunlei Li
authors.institution: MedAI Technology (Wuxi) Co. Ltd., Wuxi, China

title_en: On Robustness and Chain-of-Thought Consistency of RL-Finetuned VLMs
title_zh: 论RL微调视觉语言模型的鲁棒性与思维链一致性

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning has become a key technique for enhancing large language models (LLMs) on reasoning-intensive tasks, motivating its extension to vision language models (VLMs).
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）微调已成为在推理密集型任务上增强大语言模型（LLMs）的关键技术，这也推动了将其扩展至视觉语言模型（VLMs）。

sentences.en: While RL-tuned VLMs improve on visual reasoning benchmarks, they remain vulnerable to weak visual grounding, hallucinations, and over-reliance on textual cues.
sentences.zh: 虽然经RL调优的VLM在视觉推理基准上有所提升，但它们仍容易受到弱视觉接地、幻觉和对文本线索过度依赖的影响。

sentences.en: We show that simple, controlled textual perturbations—misleading captions or incorrect chain-of-thought (CoT) traces—cause substantial drops in robustness, and that these effects are more pronounced when CoT consistency is taken into account across open-source multimodal reasoning models.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，简单且受控的文本扰动——如误导性标题或错误的思维链（CoT）痕迹——会导致鲁棒性大幅下降，而且在跨开源多模态推理模型考察CoT一致性时，这些影响更为明显。

sentences.en: In contrast, closed models exhibit similar failure modes but maintain markedly greater robustness and reasoning consistency, suggesting that the gap reflects a shortcoming in current RL fine-tuning methods rather than an inherent limitation of the task.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，闭源模型表现出相似的失败模式，但保持了显著更强的鲁棒性和推理一致性，这表明这一差距反映的是当前RL微调方法的不足，而非任务本身的固有限制。

sentences.en: To better understand these vulnerabilities, we further analyze RL fine-tuning dynamics and uncover an accuracy–faithfulness trade-off: fine-tuning raises benchmark accuracy, but can simultaneously erode the reliability of the accompanying CoT and its robustness to contextual shifts.
sentences.zh: 为更好地理解这些脆弱性，我们进一步分析了RL微调动力学，并揭示了一个准确率-忠实度权衡：微调提高了基准准确率，但同时可能削弱伴随的CoT的可靠性及其对情境变化的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Although adversarial augmentation improves robustness, it does not by itself prevent faithfulness drift.
sentences.zh: 尽管对抗性增强提高了鲁棒性，但它本身并不能阻止忠实度漂移。

sentences.en: Incorporating a faithfulness-aware reward can restore alignment between answers and reasoning, but when paired with augmentation, training risks collapsing onto shortcut strategies.
sentences.zh: 引入一个忠实度感知的奖励可以恢复答案与推理之间的一致性，但当与增强相结合时，训练可能崩塌到捷径策略上。

sentences.en: Together, these findings highlight the limitations of accuracy-only evaluations and motivate training and assessment protocols that jointly emphasize correctness, robustness, and consistency in visually grounded reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这些发现共同凸显了仅以准确率评估的局限性，并促使我们在视觉接地推理中采用同时强调正确性、鲁棒性和一致性的训练与评估协议。

title_en: On Stable Long-Form Generation: Benchmarking and Mitigating Length Volatility
title_zh: 论稳定的长文本生成：长度波动性的基准测试与缓解

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at long-context understanding but exhibit significant limitations in long-form generation.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在长上下文理解方面表现出色，但在长文本生成方面存在显著局限。

sentences.en: Existing studies primarily focus on single-generation quality, generally overlooking the volatility of the output (i.e., the inconsistency in length and content across multiple generations).
sentences.zh: 现有研究主要聚焦于单次生成的质量，通常忽略了输出的波动性（即多次生成之间在长度和内容上的不一致性）。

sentences.en: This volatility not only leads to significant computational costs but also severely impacts the models' reliable application.
sentences.zh: 这种波动性不仅导致显著的计算成本，还严重影响了模型应用的可靠性。

sentences.en: To address this gap, our work unfolds in three stages: benchmarking, probing, and mitigation.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们的工作分为三个阶段推进：基准测试、探针分析和缓解。

sentences.en: We first propose the VOlatility in Long-form Text Benchmark (VOLTBench), a novel heterogeneous-task benchmark designed to systematically quantify the length volatility of long-form generation.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出长文本波动性基准（VOLTBench），一个新颖的异质任务基准，旨在系统性量化长文本生成的长度波动性。

sentences.en: Subsequently, by analyzing attention traces, we conduct an in-depth probe to identify several common internal patterns that cause this volatility.
sentences.zh: 随后，通过分析注意力迹线，我们进行深入探针分析，识别出导致这种波动性的几种常见内部模式。

sentences.en: Finally, to mitigate long-form output volatility, we propose SELB (Structural Enforcement via Logits Boosting), a lightweight decoding-stage optimization strategy, designed to significantly enhance both the length accuracy and stability of long-form generation without additional training.
sentences.zh: 最后，为缓解长文本输出的波动性，我们提出SELB（通过Logits提升进行结构约束），一种轻量级的解码阶段优化策略，旨在无需额外训练即可显著提升长文本生成的长度准确性和稳定性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on VOLTBench provide the first systematic confirmation of severe long-form output instability in mainstream models and validate that our proposed method successfully improves the mean output length of the base model by 148% and reduces the length volatility by 69%, while maintaining high generation quality.
sentences.zh: 在VOLTBench上进行的大量实验首次系统性地证实了主流模型存在严重的长文本输出不稳定性，并验证了我们提出的方法能成功将基座模型的平均输出长度提升148%，将长度波动性降低69%，同时保持较高的生成质量。

title_en: On Structured State-Space Duality
title_zh: 论结构化状态空间对偶性

sentences.en: Structured State-Space Duality (SSD)  [Dao \& Gu, ICML 2024] is an equivalence between a simple Structured State-Space Model (SSM) and a masked attention mechanism.
sentences.zh: 结构化状态空间对偶性（SSD）[Dao \& Gu, ICML 2024]是一个简单结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与掩码注意力机制之间的等价关系。

sentences.en: In particular, a state-space model with a scalar-times-identity state matrix is equivalent to a masked self-attention with a $1$-semiseparable causal mask.
sentences.zh: 特别地，具有标量乘单位状态矩阵的状态空间模型等价于具有 $1$-半可分离因果掩码的掩码自注意力。

sentences.en: Consequently, the same sequence transformation (model) has two algorithmic realizations:  as a linear-time $O(T)$ recurrence or as a quadratic-time $O(T^2)$ attention.
sentences.zh: 因此，同一个序列变换（模型）具有两种算法实现：即线性时间 $O(T)$ 的递推，或二次时间 $O(T^2)$ 的注意力。

sentences.en: In this note, we formalize and generalize this duality: (i)  we extend SSD from the scalar‑identity case to general diagonal SSMs (diagonal state matrices);  (ii) we show that these diagonal SSMs match the scalar case's training complexity lower bounds while supporting richer dynamics; (iii) we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which an SSM is equivalent to $1$-semiseparable masked attention;  and (iv) we show that such duality fails to extend to standard softmax attention due to rank explosion.
sentences.zh: 在本说明中，我们形式化并推广了这一对偶性：（i）我们将SSD从标量-单位情形推广到一般对角SSM（对角状态矩阵）；（ii）我们证明这些对角SSM在保持更丰富动力学的同时，达到与标量情形相同的训练复杂度下界；（iii）我们建立了SSM等价于 $1$-半可分离掩码注意力的一个充要条件；（iv）我们表明由于秩爆炸，此类对偶性无法推广到标准softmax注意力。

sentences.en: Together, these results tighten the bridge between recurrent SSMs and Transformers, and widen the design space for expressive yet efficient sequence models.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同拉近了递推SSM与Transformer之间的桥梁，并拓宽了既富有表现力又高效的序列模型的设计空间。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/MAGICS-LAB/state_space_daulity.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/MAGICS-LAB/state_space_daulity 获取。

title_en: On Testing Conditional Mean Independence for Manifold-Valued Data
title_zh: 流形值数据的条件均值独立性检验

sentences.en: This paper introduces a nonparametric test for conditional mean independence between a manifold‑valued $Y$ and Euclidean predictors $X$.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了一种针对流形值 $Y$ 与欧几里得预测变量 $X$ 之间条件均值独立性的非参数检验。

sentences.en: The test is built on a new measure called the Manifold Martingale Difference Divergence (MMDD), which characterizes conditional mean dependence by projecting observations onto the tangent space via the logarithmic map.
sentences.zh: 该检验基于一个称为流形鞅差散度（MMDD）的新测度，它通过对数映射将观测投影到切空间，从而刻画条件均值依赖关系。

sentences.en: We provide an empirical estimator for the MMDD, establish its asymptotic null distribution, and implement a wild bootstrap procedure for finite‑sample inference.
sentences.zh: 我们为MMDD提供了经验估计量，确立了其渐近零分布，并实现了一种用于有限样本推断的自助法（wild bootstrap）程序。

sentences.en: Simulations on three representative manifolds demonstrate that the proposed test maintains correct size under the null even when the distribution of  $Y$ depends on $X$, in contrast to the severe size distortion exhibited by the distance covariance (dCov) test.
sentences.zh: 在三个代表性流形上的模拟表明，即使在 $Y$ 的分布依赖于 $X$ 的情况下，所提检验在零假设下也能保持正确的大小，这与距离协方差（dCov）检验表现出的严重尺寸失真形成对比。

sentences.en: At the same time, it achieves competitive power across a range of alternatives.
sentences.zh: 同时，它在一系列备择假设下达到了有竞争力的检验功效。

sentences.en: An application to real data illustrates its practical utility.
sentences.zh: 对真实数据的应用说明了其实用价值。

title_en: On the "Induction Bias" in Sequence Models
title_zh: 论序列模型中的“归纳偏置”

sentences.en: Despite the remarkable practical success of transformer-based language models, recent work has raised concerns about their ability to perform state tracking.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于 transformer 的语言模型在实践上取得了非凡的成功，但近期工作对其执行状态跟踪的能力提出了担忧。

sentences.en: In particular, a growing body of literature has shown this limitation primarily through failures in out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, such as length extrapolation.
sentences.zh: 特别是，越来越多的文献主要通过分布外（OOD）泛化的失败来展示这一局限，例如长度外推。

sentences.en: In this work, we shift attention to the in-distribution implications of these limitations.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们将注意力转向这些局限在分布内的含义。

sentences.en: We conduct a large-scale experimental study of the data efficiency of transformers and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) across multiple supervision regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们开展了一项大规模实验研究，考察 transformer 和循环神经网络（RNNs）在多种监督范式下的数据效率。

sentences.en: We find that the amount of training data required by transformers grows much more rapidly with state-space size and sequence length than for RNNs.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，transformer 所需的数据量随状态空间大小和序列长度的增长远远快于 RNN。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we analyze the extent to which learned state-tracking mechanisms are shared across different sequence lengths.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们分析习得的状态跟踪机制在不同序列长度之间共享的程度。

sentences.en: We show that transformers exhibit negligible or even detrimental weight sharing across lengths, indicating that they learn length-specific solutions in isolation.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，transformer 在不同长度间表现出可忽略甚至有害的权值共享，表明它们孤立地学习针对特定长度的解决方案。

sentences.en: In contrast, recurrent models exhibit effective amortized learning by sharing weights across lengths, allowing data from one sequence length to improve performance on others.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，循环模型通过跨长度共享权重实现了有效的摊销学习，使一个序列长度的数据能够提升其他长度上的表现。

sentences.en: Together, these results demonstrate that state tracking remains a fundamental challenge for transformers, even when training and evaluation distributions match.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同表明，即使在训练和评估分布匹配的情况下，状态跟踪对 transformer 而言仍是一个根本性挑战。

title_en: On the Ability of Transformers to Verify Plans
title_zh: 论Transformer验证规划的能力

sentences.en: Transformers have shown inconsistent success in AI planning tasks, and theoretical understanding of when generalization should be expected has been limited.
sentences.zh: Transformer在AI规划任务中表现参差不齐，而关于何时应当预期泛化的理论理解一直很有限。

sentences.en: We take important steps towards addressing this gap by analyzing the ability of decoder-only models to verify whether a given plan correctly solves a given planning instance.
sentences.zh: 我们通过分析仅解码器模型验证给定规划是否正确求解给定规划实例的能力，向弥补这一差距迈出了重要步伐。

sentences.en: To analyse the general setting where the number of objects -- and thus the effective input alphabet --  grows at test time,  we introduce C*-RASP, an extension of C-RASP designed to establish length generalization guarantees for transformers under the simultaneous growth in sequence length and vocabulary size.
sentences.zh: 为分析测试时对象数量（从而有效输入字母表）增长的一般情形，我们引入了C*-RASP，它是C-RASP的扩展，旨在为Transformer在序列长度和词汇量同时增长的情况下建立长度泛化保证。

sentences.en: Our results identify a large class of classical planning domains for which transformers can provably learn to verify long plans, and structural properties that significantly affects the learnability of length generalizable solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果识别出一大类经典规划领域，Transformer在这些领域可以可证明地学会验证长规划，并识别出显著影响长度可泛化解的可学习性的结构性质。

sentences.en: Empirical experiments corroborate our theory.
sentences.zh: 实证实验验证了我们的理论。

title_en: On the Accuracy of Newton Step and Influence Function Data Attributions
title_zh: 论牛顿步与影响函数数据归因的准确性

sentences.en: Data attribution estimates how a trained model would change if a subset of training points were removed, and is a central primitive for tasks such as interpretability, data valuation, and machine unlearning.
sentences.zh: 数据归因估计算如果移除训练点子集，训练好的模型将如何变化，它是可解释性、数据估值和机器遗忘等任务的核心原语。

sentences.en: Despite its widespread use, our theoretical understanding of key data attribution methods -- Influence Functions (IF) and a single Newton Step (NS) -- remains limited: existing guarantees heavily rely on *global* strong convexity and yield bounds with pessimistic dependence on the parameter dimension $d$ and the number of removed samples $k$.
sentences.zh: 尽管应用广泛，但我们对关键数据归因方法——影响函数（IF）和单步牛顿（NS）——的理论理解仍然有限：现有保证严重依赖于*全局*强凸性，并且给出的界对参数维度 $d$ 和移除样本数 $k$ 具有悲观的依赖。

sentences.en: We give a new analysis of IF and NS for convex ERM that replaces global assumptions with *local* conditions: it suffices that the loss is strongly convex and sufficiently smooth only in a neighborhood of the first Newton step.
sentences.zh: 我们对凸ERM下的IF和NS给出了一种新的分析，用*局部*条件取代全局假设：只需损失在第一个牛顿步的邻域内满足强凸且足够光滑即可。

sentences.en: As a concrete validation, we analyze logistic regression with Gaussian features and show that our bounds capture the correct scaling up to polylogarithmic factors, yielding matching upper and lower bounds and explaining observed regimes in which NS is markedly more accurate than IF, thereby resolving open questions raised by (Koh et al., 2019).
sentences.zh: 作为具体验证，我们分析了带高斯特征的逻辑回归，并表明我们的界在多项式对数因子范围内捕捉了正确的缩放，得到匹配的上下界，并且解释了NS显著比IF更准确的观测情形，从而解决了(Koh et al., 2019)提出的开放问题。

title_en: On the Adversarial Robustness of Large Vision-Language Models under Visual Token Compression
title_zh: 论视觉词元压缩下大视觉语言模型的对抗鲁棒性

sentences.en: Visual token compression is widely used to accelerate large vision-language models (LVLMs) by pruning or merging visual tokens, yet its adversarial robustness remains unexplored.
sentences.zh: 视觉词元压缩被广泛用于通过剪枝或合并视觉词元来加速大视觉语言模型（LVLMs），但其对抗鲁棒性仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We show that existing encoder-based attacks cannot fully disclose the robustness vulnerabilities of compressed LVLMs, due to an optimization-inference mismatch: perturbations are optimized on the full-token representation, while inference is performed through a token-compression bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，现有的基于编码器的攻击无法充分揭示压缩版LVLM的鲁棒性脆弱性，这是因为存在优化-推理错配：扰动是在全词元表示上优化，而推理则通过词元压缩瓶颈进行。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose the Compression-AliGnEd attack (CAGE), which aligns perturbation optimization with compression inference without assuming access to the deployed compression mechanism or its token budget.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一差距，我们提出了压缩对齐攻击（CAGE），它在不假设能访问部署的压缩机制或其词元预算的情况下，使扰动优化与压缩推理对齐。

sentences.en: CAGE combines (i) expected feature disruption, which concentrates distortion on tokens likely to survive across plausible budgets, and (ii) rank distortion alignment, which actively aligns token distortions with rank scores to promote the retention of highly distorted evidence.
sentences.zh: CAGE结合了（i）期望特征破坏，它将在各可行预算下可能存活的词元上集中失真，以及（ii）秩失真对齐，它主动将词元失真与秩分数对齐，以促进高度失真证据的保留。

sentences.en: Across diverse representative plug-and-play compression mechanisms and datasets, our results show that CAGEconsistently achieves lower robust accuracy than the baseline.
sentences.zh: 在多种具有代表性的即插即用压缩机制和数据集上，我们的结果表明CAGE始终获得比基线更低的鲁棒准确率。

sentences.en: This work highlights that robustness assessments ignoring compression can be overly optimistic, calling for compression-aware security evaluation and defenses for efficient LVLMs.
sentences.zh: 这项工作强调，忽略压缩的鲁棒性评估可能过于乐观，呼吁对高效LVLM进行压缩感知的安全评估与防御。

title_en: On the Anisotropy of Score-Based Generative Models
title_zh: 论基于分数的生成模型的各向异性

sentences.en: We investigate the role of network architecture in shaping the inductive biases of modern score-based generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们研究网络架构在塑造现代基于分数的生成模型的归纳偏置中的作用。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce the Score Anisotropy Directions (SADs), architecture-dependent directions that reveal how different networks preferentially capture data structure.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了分数各向异性方向（SADs）——与架构相关的方向，揭示不同网络如何优先捕捉数据结构。

sentences.en: Our analysis suggests that SADs form adaptive bases aligned with the architecture's output geometry, providing a principled way to predict generalization ability in score models prior to training.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，SADs形成与架构输出几何对齐的适应性基，为在训练之前预测分数模型的泛化能力提供了一条有原则的途径。

sentences.en: Through both synthetic data and standard image benchmarks, we demonstrate that SADs reliably capture fine-grained model behavior and correlate with downstream performance, as measured by Wasserstein metrics.
sentences.zh: 通过合成数据和标准图像基准，我们证明SADs能够可靠地捕捉细粒度模型行为，并与下游性能相关联（以Wasserstein度量衡量）。

sentences.en: Our work offers a new lens for explaining and predicting directional biases of generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为解释和预测生成模型的方向性偏置提供了一种新视角。

title_en: On the Collapse of Generative Paths: A Criterion and Correction for Diffusion Steering
title_zh: 论生成路径的崩塌：扩散引导的判据与修正

sentences.en: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow models to new tasks without retraining, often utilizing ratio-of-densities constructions that reweight time-indexed marginals with fixed exponents.
sentences.zh: 推理时引导无需重训即可使预训练的扩散和流模型适配新任务，通常利用密度比结构，以固定指数对按时间索引的边际概率进行加权。

sentences.en: We identify Marginal Path Collapse, a failure mode in which the intermediate density defined by such compositions becomes non-normalizable despite valid endpoints.
sentences.zh: 我们发现了边际路径崩塌（Marginal Path Collapse）这一失效模式，即由这类组合定义的中间密度尽管端点有效，却变得不可归一化。

sentences.en: This collapse can arise when composing heterogeneous experts trained with mismatched noise schedules (and/or negative exponents / partial supports).
sentences.zh: 这种崩塌可能出现在组合使用以不匹配噪声调度（和/或负指数/部分支持）训练的异构专家时。

sentences.en: To address this, we provide (i) a sharp sufficient Path Existence Criterion that characterizes when the composed intermediate densities are mathematically well-defined, and (ii) Adaptive Path Correction with Exponents (ACE), which generalizes Feynman–Kac steering to support time-varying exponents.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提供了（i）一个尖锐且充分的路径存在性判据，刻画组合后的中间密度在数学上何时良定义，以及（ii）带指数的自适应路径修正（ACE），它将Feynman–Kac引导推广到支持时变指数。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that ACE controls the quantile radius of the intermediate distributions, providing a theoretical mechanism for path stabilization observed in experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，ACE控制中间分布的分位数半径，为实验中观察到的路径稳定化提供了理论机制。

sentences.en: On flexible-pose scaffold decoration, a drug design task composed of de-novo, conformer, and protein-conditioned experts, ACE prevents collapse and significantly outperforms constant-exponent baselines.
sentences.zh: 在柔性姿态骨架装饰这一由从头设计、构象和蛋白条件专家组合而成的药物设计任务中，ACE防止了崩塌，并且显著优于恒定指数基线。

sentences.en: Furthermore, ACE improves attribute success rates in compositional image generation, establishing it as a general framework for compositional sampling.
sentences.zh: 此外，ACE在组合图像生成中提升了属性成功率，确立了其作为组合采样通用框架的地位。
