title_en: On the Computational Complexity of Performative Prediction
title_zh: 论表现性预测的计算复杂度

sentences.en: Performative prediction captures the phenomenon where deploying a predictive model shifts the underlying data distribution.
sentences.zh: 表现性预测刻画了部署预测模型会转移底层数据分布这一现象。

sentences.en: While simple retraining dynamics are known to converge linearly when the performative effects are weak ($\rho < 1$), the complexity in the regime $\rho > 1$ was hitherto open.
sentences.zh: 当表现效应较弱（$\rho < 1$）时，简单的重训动力学已知可线性收敛，但在 $\rho > 1$ 区间的复杂度此前仍是开放问题。

sentences.en: In this paper, we establish a sharp phase transition: computing an $\epsilon$-performatively stable point is PPAD-complete---and thus polynomial-time equivalent to Nash equilibria in general-sum games---even when $\rho = 1 + O(\epsilon)$.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们建立了一个尖锐的相变：即使当 $\rho = 1 + O(\epsilon)$ 时，计算 $\epsilon$-表现性稳定点也是PPAD完全的——因此在多项式时间内等价于一般和博弈中的Nash均衡。

sentences.en: This intractability persists even in the ostensibly simple setting with a quadratic loss function and linear distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 即使在具有二次损失函数和线性分布偏移这类看似简单的情形下，这种难解性依然存在。

sentences.en: One of our key technical contributions is to extend this PPAD-hardness result to general convex domains, which is of broader interest in the complexity of variational inequalities.
sentences.zh: 我们的一项关键技术贡献是将这一PPAD-难性结果推广到一般凸域，这在变分不等式的复杂度研究中具有更广泛的意义。

sentences.en: Finally, we address the special case of strategic classification, showing that computing a strategic local optimum is PLS-hard.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们处理了策略分类这一特例，证明计算策略局部最优是PLS难的。

title_en: On the Convergence of Adaptive Gradient Methods for Nonconvex Optimization
title_zh: 论非凸优化中自适应梯度方法的收敛性

sentences.en: Adaptive gradient methods are workhorses in deep learning.
sentences.zh: 自适应梯度方法是深度学习中的主力工具。

sentences.en: However, the convergence guarantees of adaptive gradient methods for nonconvex optimization have not been thoroughly studied.
sentences.zh: 然而，自适应梯度方法在非凸优化中的收敛保证尚未得到深入研究。

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a fine-grained convergence analysis for a general class of adaptive gradient methods including AMSGrad, RMSProp and AdaGrad.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们对包括AMSGrad、RMSProp和AdaGrad在内的一大类自适应梯度方法提供了细粒度的收敛分析。

sentences.en: For smooth nonconvex functions, we prove that adaptive gradient methods in expectation converge to a first-order stationary point.
sentences.zh: 对于光滑非凸函数，我们证明自适应梯度方法在期望意义下收敛到一阶驻点。

sentences.en: Our convergence rate is better than existing results for adaptive gradient methods in terms of dimension.
sentences.zh: 在维度方面，我们的收敛速率优于现有的自适应梯度方法结果。

sentences.en: In addition, we also prove high probability bounds on the convergence rates of AMSGrad, RMSProp as well as AdaGrad, which have not been established before.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还证明了AMSGrad、RMSProp以及AdaGrad收敛速率的高概率界，这些界此前从未建立。

sentences.en: Our analyses shed light on better understanding the mechanism behind adaptive gradient methods in optimizing nonconvex objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析有助于更好地理解自适应梯度方法在优化非凸目标背后的机制。

title_en: On the Convergence of Decentralized Stochastic Minimax Optimization Algorithm with Compressed Communication
title_zh: 论带压缩通信的分布式随机极小极大优化算法的收敛性

sentences.en: The stochastic minimax optimization problem has widespread applications in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 随机极小极大优化问题在机器学习中有着广泛的应用。

sentences.en: Recently, numerous distributed minimax optimization algorithms have been developed to handle distributed training data.
sentences.zh: 近年来，人们开发了大量分布式极小极大优化算法来处理分布式训练数据。

sentences.en: However, most of these algorithms suffer from high communication costs.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些算法大多面临较高的通信成本。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we develop a novel communication-efficient decentralized stochastic gradient descent ascent with momentum algorithm based on the error feedback mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们基于误差反馈机制，开发了一种新颖的、通信高效的分布式带动量随机梯度上升下降算法。

sentences.en: Importantly, our algorithm demonstrates how to balance the full-precision update and the compression residual with novel designs for coefficients regarding variables and gradients to guarantee convergence.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我们的算法通过针对变量和梯度系数的新颖设计，展示了如何平衡全精度更新与压缩残差以保证收敛。

sentences.en: However, compressing the primal and dual variables (and their gradients) of stochastic minimax optimization problems with the error feedback mechanism presents significant challenges for convergence analysis.
sentences.zh: 然而，结合误差反馈机制压缩随机极小极大优化问题的原始变量和对偶变量（及其梯度），给收敛性分析带来了重大挑战。

sentences.en: In particular, it incurs the circle dependence among consensus errors and compression errors.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，它在共识误差与压缩误差之间引入了循环依赖。

sentences.en: To overcome this challenge, we propose novel strategies that enable the establishment of the convergence rate for our algorithm.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一挑战，我们提出了新颖的策略，使我们能够为算法建立收敛速率。

sentences.en: Our theoretical results demonstrate how the compression operator influences the convergence rate.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论结果展示了压缩算子如何影响收敛速率。

sentences.en: Finally, extensive experimental results confirm the efficacy of our proposed algorithm.
sentences.zh: 最后，大量实验结果证实了我们所提算法的有效性。

title_en: On the Convergence Rate of LoRA Gradient Descent
title_zh: 论LoRA梯度下降的收敛速率

sentences.en: The low-rank adaptation (LoRA) algorithm for fine-tuning large models has grown popular in recent years due to its remarkable performance and low computational requirements.
sentences.zh: 用于微调大模型的低秩适配（LoRA）算法近年因其出色的性能和较低的计算需求而广受欢迎。

sentences.en: LoRA trains two "adapter" matrices that form a low-rank representation of the model parameters, thereby massively reducing the number of parameters that need to be updated at every step.
sentences.zh: LoRA训练两个构成模型参数低秩表示的“适配器”矩阵，从而大幅减少每一步需要更新的参数数量。

sentences.en: Although LoRA is simple, its convergence is poorly understood due to the lack of Lipschitz smoothness, a key condition for classic convergence analyses.
sentences.zh: 虽然LoRA很简单，但由于缺乏Lipschitz光滑性（经典收敛分析的关键条件），其收敛性仍难被充分理解。

sentences.en: As a result, current theoretical results only consider asymptotic behavior or assume strong boundedness conditions which artificially enforce Lipschitz smoothness.
sentences.zh: 因此，现有的理论结果要么只考虑渐近行为，要么假设人为强制Lipschitz光滑性的强有界条件。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide for the first time a non-asymptotic convergence analysis of the *original LoRA gradient descent* algorithm, which reflects widespread practice, without such assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们首次在无此类假设的情况下，反映了广泛实践的对*原始LoRA梯度下降*算法进行了非渐近收敛分析。

sentences.en: Our work relies on three key steps: i) reformulating the problem in terms of the outer product of the stacked adapter matrices, ii) a modified descent lemma for the "Lipschitz-like" reparametrized function, and iii) controlling the step size.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作依赖于三个关键步骤：i）将问题重新表述为堆叠适配器矩阵的外积形式，ii）为“类Lipschitz”重参数化函数导出一个修正的下降引理，以及iii）控制步长。

sentences.en: With this approach, we prove that LoRA gradient descent converges to a stationary point at rate $O(\frac{1}{\log T})$, where $T$ is the number of iterations.
sentences.zh: 采用这种方法，我们证明LoRA梯度下降以 $O(\frac{1}{\log T})$ 的速率收敛到驻点，其中 $T$ 为迭代次数。

sentences.en: We conduct numerical experiments to validate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了数值实验以验证我们的理论发现。

title_en: On the Coordination of Value-Maximizing Bidders
title_zh: 论价值最大化竞标者的协同

sentences.en: While the auto-bidding literature predominantly considers independent bidding, we investigate the coordination problem among multiple auto-bidders in online advertising platforms.
sentences.zh: 虽然自动出价文献主要关注独立出价，但我们研究在线广告平台中多个自动出价者之间的协同问题。

sentences.en: Two motivating scenarios are: collaborative bidding among multiple bidders managed by a third-party bidding agent, and strategic bid selection for multiple ad campaigns managed by a single advertiser.
sentences.zh: 两个动机场景是：由第三方出价智能体管理的多个竞标者之间的协作出价，以及由单个广告主管理的多个广告活动的策略性出价选择。

sentences.en: We formalize this coordination problem as a theoretical model and investigate the coordination mechanism where only the highest-value bidder competes with outside bidders, while other coordinated bidders refrain from competing.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一协同问题形式化为一个理论模型，并研究仅由最高价值竞标者与外部竞标者竞争、而其他协同竞标者不参与竞争的协同机制。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that such a coordination mechanism dominates independent bidding, improving both Return-on-Spend (RoS) compliance and the total value accrued for the participating auto-bidders or ad campaigns, for a broad class of auto-bidding algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对一大类自动出价算法而言，这种协同机制优于独立出价，既提高了投资回报率（RoS）合规性，又增加了参与的自动出价者或广告活动所累积的总价值。

sentences.en: Additionally, our simulations on synthetic and real-world datasets support the theoretical result that coordination outperforms independent bidding.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在合成数据集和真实数据集上的模拟支持了协同优于独立出价的理论结果。

sentences.en: These findings highlight both the theoretical potential and the practical robustness of coordinated auto-bidding in online auctions.
sentences.zh: 这些发现既凸显了在线拍卖中协同自动出价的理论潜力，也展示了其实用鲁棒性。

authors.name: Tao Lin
authors.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: On the Difficulty of Learning a Meta-network for Training Data Selection
title_zh: 论学习用于训练数据选择的元网络的困难性

sentences.en: Synthetic data are increasingly used to train image classifiers, yet distributional mismatch with real data limits their effectiveness when used indiscriminately.
sentences.zh: 合成数据越来越多地被用于训练图像分类器，然而与真实数据的分布不匹配限制了它们在不加区分使用时的有效性。

sentences.en: A common strategy is to learn data weights via bi-level optimization, which we refer to as Meta-learning for Training-data Selection (MTS).
sentences.zh: 一种常见策略是通过双层优化学习数据权重，我们称之为训练数据选择的元学习（MTS）。

sentences.en: Interestingly, in practice, MTS often performs below expectation.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在实践中MTS的表现常常低于预期。

sentences.en: We identify two obstacles in properly training MTS: a poor gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR), which causes optimization difficulties, and lack of informative features that correlates with data quality.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出正确训练MTS的两个障碍：较差的梯度信噪比（GSNR）会造成优化困难，以及缺乏与数据质量相关的信息量大特征。

sentences.en: We present a thorough mathematical analysis of MTS, which reveals the dynamics of normalized data weights and the relation between disparate data quality and poor GSNR.
sentences.zh: 我们对MTS进行了透彻的数学分析，揭示了归一化数据权重的动力学，以及参差不齐的数据质量与较差GSNR之间的关系。

sentences.en: The analysis suggests a a simple yet effective solution: increasing the batch size.
sentences.zh: 该分析提出一个简单而有效的解决方案：增大批大小。

sentences.en: Further, we propose a set of informative features that capture the positions of training data in their distributions and training dynamics.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一组信息量大的特征，捕捉训练数据在其分布中的位置以及训练动力学。

sentences.en: Experiments across four benchmarks show consistent improvements, achieving average gains of 5.49\% over training without selection and 2.89\% over the strongest baseline.
sentences.zh: 在四个基准上的实验显示出一致的改进，平均比不选择训练提升5.49\%，比最强基线提升2.89\%。

title_en: On the Effect of Misspecifying the Embedding Dimension in Low-rank Network Models
title_zh: 论低秩网络模型中嵌入维度误设的影响

sentences.en: As network data has become ubiquitous in the sciences, there has been growing interest in network models whose structure is driven by latent node-level variables in a (typically low-dimensional) latent geometric space.
sentences.zh: 随着网络数据在科学领域变得无处不在，人们对结构由（通常低维的）潜在几何空间中潜在节点级变量驱动的网络模型兴趣日益浓厚。

sentences.en: These "latent positions" are often estimated via embeddings, whereby the nodes of a network are mapped to points in Euclidean space so that  "similar" nodes are mapped to nearby points.
sentences.zh: 这些“潜在位置”通常通过嵌入来估计，即将网络的节点映射到欧几里得空间中的点，使得“相似”的节点被映射到邻近的点。

sentences.en: Under certain model assumptions, these embeddings are consistent estimates of the latent positions, but most such results require the embedding dimension to be chosen correctly.
sentences.zh: 在某些模型假设下，这些嵌入是潜在位置的一致估计，但大多数这类结果要求嵌入维度选择正确。

sentences.en: Methods for choosing the embedding dimension have been studied extensively, but little is known about the behavior of embeddings when the dimension is misspecified.
sentences.zh: 选择嵌入维度的方法已被广泛研究，但关于维度误设时嵌入行为的了解却很少。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a theoretical description of the effects of dimension misspecification under the random dot product graph, a class of latent space network models that includes several widely-used network models, most notably the stochastic blockmodel, as special cases.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们在随机点积图下对维度误设的影响给出理论描述；随机点积图是一类潜在空间网络模型，包含了若干广泛使用的网络模型（最值得注意的是随机块模型）作为特例。

sentences.en: We show that when the dimension is chosen too large, consistent estimation still holds, albeit at a slower rate than when the embedding dimension is chosen correctly.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，当维度选择过大时，一致性估计仍然成立，只是速率比维度选择正确时慢。

sentences.en: On the other hand, when the dimension is chosen too small, there is a fundamental estimation error lower bound that need not go to zero in the large-network limit.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，当维度选择过小时，存在一个在大网络极限下不必趋于零的基本估计误差下界。

sentences.en: A range of synthetic data experiments support our theoretical results.
sentences.zh: 一系列合成数据实验支持了我们的理论结果。

sentences.en: Our main technical result, which may be of independent interest, is a generalization of earlier work in random matrix theory showing that all non-signal eigenvectors of a low-rank matrix subject to additive noise are delocalized.
sentences.zh: 我们主要的理论贡献（可能具有独立价值）是对早期随机矩阵理论工作的推广，表明受加性噪声干扰的低秩矩阵的所有非信号特征向量都是离域的。

title_en: On the Emergence of Implicit Curriculum in RLVR Learning Dynamics
title_zh: 论RLVR学习动力学中隐式课程的出现

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been a main driver of recent breakthroughs in large reasoning models.
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）一直是近期大推理模型突破的主要驱动力。

sentences.en: Yet it remains a mystery how rewards based solely on final outcomes can help overcome the long-horizon barrier to extended reasoning.
sentences.zh: 然而，仅基于最终结果的奖励如何能帮助克服长时间推理的长期跨度障碍，仍是一个谜。

sentences.en: To understand this, we develop a theory of the training dynamics of RLVR for transformers on compositional reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 为理解这一点，我们为组合推理任务上transformer的RLVR训练动力学发展了一套理论。

sentences.en: Our theory shows that mixed-difficulty training naturally induces an **implicit curriculum**: without any explicit schedule, easier problems become learnable first and shape the frontier for harder ones, creating a learning progression from easy to hard during optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论表明，混合难度训练会自然地诱导一种**隐式课程**：无需任何显式调度，较容易的问题会先变得可学，并塑造更难问题的前沿，从而在优化过程中形成从易到难的学习进程。

sentences.en: The effectiveness of this curriculum is governed by the smoothness of the difficulty spectrum.
sentences.zh: 这种课程的有效性由难度谱的光滑性所支配。

sentences.en: When the spectrum is smooth, training dynamics enter a well-behaved *relay* regime, in which persistent gradient signals on easier problems make slightly harder ones tractable and keep training at the edge of competence.
sentences.zh: 当谱光滑时，训练动力学进入表现良好的*中继*（relay）状态，在此状态下，较容易问题上持续的梯度信号使略难的问题变得可处理，并使训练保持在能力边缘。

sentences.en: When the spectrum contains abrupt discontinuities, training undergoes grokking-type phase transitions with prolonged plateaus before progress recurs.
sentences.zh: 当谱包含突然的不连续时，训练会经历grokking式的相变，并有漫长的平台期之后才再次取得进展。

sentences.en: As a technical contribution, our analysis develops and adapts techniques from Fourier analysis on finite groups to our setting.
sentences.zh: 作为技术贡献，我们的分析开发并适配了有限群上傅里叶分析的技术到我们的场景。

sentences.en: We validate the predicted mechanisms empirically via synthetic experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们通过合成实验实证验证了所预测的机制。

title_en: On the Entropy Dynamics in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
title_zh: 论大语言模型强化微调中的熵动力学

sentences.en: Entropy serves as a critical metric for measuring the diversity of outputs generated by large language models (LLMs), providing valuable insights into their exploration capabilities.
sentences.zh: 熵是衡量大语言模型（LLMs）生成输出多样性的关键指标，为其探索能力提供了宝贵的洞见。

sentences.en: While recent studies increasingly focus on monitoring and adjusting entropy to better balance exploration and exploitation in reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), a principled understanding of entropy dynamics during this process is yet to be thoroughly investigated.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期研究越来越关注在强化微调（RFT）中监测和调整熵以更好地平衡探索与利用，但对该过程中熵动力学的原则性理解仍有待深入研究。

sentences.en: In this paper, we establish a theoretical framework for analyzing the entropy dynamics during the RFT process, which begins with a discriminant expression that quantifies entropy change under a single logit update.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为分析RFT过程中的熵动力学建立了一个理论框架，其起点是一个量化单次logit更新下熵变化的判别式表达式。

sentences.en: This foundation enables the derivation of a first-order expression for entropy change, which can be further extended to the update formula of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
sentences.zh: 这一基础使我们能够推导熵变化的一阶表达式，并可进一步推广到分组相对策略优化（GRPO）的更新公式。

sentences.en: The corollaries and insights drawn from the theoretical analysis inspire the design of entropy control methods, and also offer a unified lens for interpreting various entropy-based methods in existing studies.
sentences.zh: 从理论分析中得到的推论和洞见启发了熵控制方法的设计，也为解释现有研究中各种基于熵的方法提供了统一视角。

sentences.en: We provide empirical evidence to support the main conclusions of our analysis and demonstrate the effectiveness of the derived entropy-discriminator clipping methods.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了实证证据来支持分析的主要结论，并展示了所推导的熵判别器裁剪方法的有效性。

sentences.en: This study yields novel insights into RFT training dynamics, providing theoretical support and practical strategies for optimizing the exploration-exploitation balance during LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 本研究为RFT训练动力学提供了新颖洞见，为优化LLM微调中的探索-利用平衡提供了理论支持和实用策略。

sentences.en: We release our code at https://github.com/agentscope-ai/Trinity-RFT/tree/main/examples/entropy.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/agentscope-ai/Trinity-RFT/tree/main/examples/entropy 发布了代码。

title_en: On the Epistemic Uncertainty of Overparametrized Neural Networks
title_zh: 论过参数化神经网络的认知不确定性

sentences.en: Epistemic uncertainty is often viewed as a reducible uncertainty that vanishes with increasing data.
sentences.zh: 认知不确定性通常被视为一种可减少的不确定性，会随数据的增加而消失。

sentences.en: This perspective implicitly assumes parameter identifiability and equates epistemic uncertainty with predictive variability.
sentences.zh: 这种视角隐含地假设参数可识别，并将认知不确定性与预测变异性等同起来。

sentences.en: In overparametrized neural networks, however, model parameters are typically non-identifiable due to symmetries and redundant representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，在过参数化神经网络中，由于对称性和冗余表示，模型参数通常是不可识别的。

sentences.en: As a consequence, substantial parameter uncertainty can persist even when the underlying function is fully identified.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使底层函数被完全识别，大量的参数不确定性仍可能持续存在。

sentences.en: In this work, we analyze epistemic uncertainty through the lens of non-identifiability and characterize both discrete and continuous sources of residual uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从不可识别的视角分析认知不确定性，并刻画离散和连续两种残余不确定性的来源。

sentences.en: Focusing on one-hidden-layer ReLU networks, we thoroughly analyze the resulting posterior structure and validate our theoretical insights through empirical studies.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于单隐层ReLU网络，深入分析了由此产生的后验结构，并通过实证研究验证了我们的理论洞见。

title_en: On the existence of consistent adversarial attacks in high-dimensional linear classification
title_zh: 论高维线性分类中一致对抗攻击的存在性

sentences.en: What fundamentally distinguishes an adversarial attack from a misclassification due to limited model expressivity or finite data?
sentences.zh: 是什么从根本上将对抗攻击与因模型表达力有限或数据有限而导致的错误分类区分开来？

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate this question in the setting of high-dimensional binary classification, where statistical effects due to limited data availability play a central role.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们于高维二分类设置下研究这一问题，其中数据有限性导致的统计效应起核心作用。

sentences.en: We introduce a new error metric that precisely capture this distinction, quantifying model vulnerability to consistent adversarial attacks --- perturbations that preserve the ground-truth labels.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个新的误差指标，精确捕捉这一区别，量化模型对一致对抗攻击（——即保持真值标签的扰动）的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Our main technical contribution is an exact and rigorous asymptotic characterization of these metrics in both well-specified models and latent space models, revealing different vulnerability patterns compared to standard robust error measures.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要技术贡献是对良设定模型和潜在空间模型中这些指标给出精确且严谨的渐近刻画，揭示了与标准鲁棒误差度量相比不同的脆弱性模式。

sentences.en: The theoretical results demonstrate that as models become more overparameterized, their vulnerability to label-preserving perturbations grows, offering theoretical insight into the mechanisms underlying model sensitivity to adversarial attacks.
sentences.zh: 理论结果表明，随着模型越发过参数化，其对保持标签扰动的脆弱性不断增大，为理解模型对抗攻击敏感性的机制提供了理论洞见。

authors.name: Lenka Zdeborova
authors.institution: Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne

title_en: On the Expressive Power of GNNs to Solve Linear SDPs
title_zh: 论GNN求解线性半定规划的表达能力

sentences.en: Semidefinite programs (SDPs) are a powerful framework for convex optimization and for constructing strong relaxations of hard combinatorial problems.
sentences.zh: 半定规划（SDPs）是凸优化以及构造困难组合问题强松弛的一个强大框架。

sentences.en: However, solving large SDPs can be computationally expensive, motivating the use of machine learning models as fast computational surrogates.
sentences.zh: 然而，求解大规模SDP可能计算代价高昂，这促使人们使用机器学习模型作为快速计算替代品。

sentences.en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a natural candidate in this setting due to their sparsity-awareness and ability to model variable-constraint interactions.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNNs）在此设定中是自然的候选，因为它们具有稀疏感知能力，并能建模变量-约束交互。

sentences.en: In this work, we study what expressive power is sufficient to recover optimal SDP solutions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究需要怎样的表达能力才能恢复最优SDP解。

sentences.en: We first prove negative results showing that standard GNN architectures fail on recovering linear SDP solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们首先证明了否定性结果，表明标准GNN架构在恢复线性SDP解上会失败。

sentences.en: We then identify a more expressive architecture that captures the key structure of SDPs and can, in particular, emulate the updates of a standard first-order solver.
sentences.zh: 然后我们识别出一种更具表达力的架构，它捕捉了SDP的关键结构，并能尤其模拟标准一阶求解器的更新。

sentences.en: Empirically, on both synthetic and SDPLIB benchmarks of various classes of SDPs, this more expressive architecture achieves consistently lower prediction error and objective gap than theoretically weaker baselines.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据和各类SDP的SDPLIB基准上，这种更具表达力的架构在预测误差和目标间隙方面一致地优于理论上较弱的基线。

sentences.en: Finally, using the learned high-quality predictions to warm-start the first-order solver yields practical speedups of up to 80%.
sentences.zh: 最后，利用学得的高质量预测来热启动一阶求解器，可实现高达80%的实际加速。

title_en: On the Expressive Power of Permutation-Equivariant Weight-Space Networks
title_zh: 论置换等变权值空间网络的表达能力

sentences.en: Weight-space learning studies neural architectures that operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks.
sentences.zh: 权值空间学习研究直接作用于其他神经网络参数的神经架构。

sentences.en: Motivated by the growing availability of pretrained models, recent work has demonstrated the effectiveness of weight-space networks across a wide range of tasks.
sentences.zh: 受预训练模型日益增多的启发，近期工作已在广泛任务上展示了权值空间网络的有效性。

sentences.en: SOTA weight-space networks rely on permutation-equivariant designs to improve generalization.
sentences.zh: 最先进的权值空间网络依赖置换等变设计来提升泛化。

sentences.en: However, this may negatively affect expressive power, warranting theoretical investigation.
sentences.zh: 然而，这可能对表达能力产生负面影响，需要进行理论调查。

sentences.en: Importantly, unlike other structured domains, weight-space learning targets maps operating on both weight and function spaces, making expressivity analysis particularly subtle.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，与其他结构化域不同，权值空间学习针对的是同时在权值空间和函数空间上运作的映射，这使得表达性分析尤为微妙。

sentences.en: While a few prior works provide partial expressivity results, a comprehensive characterization is still missing.
sentences.zh: 虽然少数先前工作提供了部分表达性结果，但仍缺少全面的刻画。

sentences.en: In this work, we address this gap by developing a systematic theory for expressivity of weight-space networks.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过为权值空间网络的表达性建立一套系统性理论来弥补这一空白。

sentences.en: We first prove that all prominent permutation-equivariant networks are equivalent in expressive power.
sentences.zh: 我们首先证明所有著名的置换等变网络在表达能力上是等价的。

sentences.en: We then establish universality in both weight- and function-space settings under mild, natural assumptions on the input weights, and characterize the edge-case regimes where universality no longer holds.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们在对输入权值的温和、自然假设下，建立了权值空间和函数空间两种设定下的普遍性，并刻画了普遍性不再成立的边缘情形。

sentences.en: Together, these results provide a strong and unified foundation for the expressivity of weight-space networks.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同为权值空间网络的表达性提供了强有力且统一的基础。

authors.name: Yam Eitan
authors.institution: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology, Technion

title_en: On the Fragility of Data Attribution When Learning Is Distributed
title_zh: 论分布式学习时数据归因的脆弱性

sentences.en: Data attribution has become an important component of pricing, auditing, and governance in machine learning pipelines, yet most attribution methods implicitly assume that attribution values faithfully reflect participants' contributions.
sentences.zh: 数据归因已成为机器学习流水线中定价、审计和治理的重要组成部分，然而大多数归因方法隐式假设归因值忠实地反映参与者的贡献。

sentences.en: We show that this assumption can fail: a single participant in a standard distributed training workflow can substantially inflate its measured attribution value while preserving global utility.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这一假设可能失效：在标准分布式训练流程中，单个参与者可以在保持全局效用的同时大幅虚增其被测得的归因值。

sentences.en: Our attribution-first attack uses latent optimization to inject small synthetic batches that preserve utility while exploiting non-IID label coverage and evaluator sensitivities.
sentences.zh: 我们的归因优先攻击利用潜在优化注入小的合成批次，这些批次在保持效用的同时利用非IID标签覆盖和评估器敏感性。

sentences.en: Across datasets, models, and multiple marginal-utility evaluators, the attack consistently increases the adversary’s attribution value and reshapes the relative attribution structure among benign clients without degrading accuracy or triggering geometry-based defenses.
sentences.zh: 在多个数据集、模型和多种边际效用评估器下，该攻击一致地增加攻击者的归因值，并重塑良性客户之间的相对归因结构，而不降低准确率或触发基于几何形状的防御。

sentences.en: These results show that attribution itself forms a new attack surface and motivate the development of attribution-robust and incentive-compatible scoring mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明归因本身构成了一个新的攻击面，并促使开发对归因鲁棒且激励相容的评分机制。

title_en: On the Generalization Gap in Self-Evolving Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: 论自进化语言模型推理中的泛化差距

sentences.en: Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can improve through self-evolution (SE), using supervision signals generated by the model itself.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，大语言模型（LLMs）可以通过自进化（SE）——利用模型自身生成的监督信号——来提升自身。

sentences.en: In this work, we ask: under a strict closed-loop setup, where the SE algorithm has access only to an unlabeled prompt set and a base model, how close can internally generated supervision come to oracle-supervised training?
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出疑问：在严格的闭环设定下，当SE算法只能访问无标注提示集和一个基座模型时，内部生成的监督与神谕监督训练能有多接近？

sentences.en: We analyze four representative strategies in a unified offline self-evolution framework, including single-round verification, multi-turn revision with feedback, iterative training, and curriculum learning.
sentences.zh: 我们在统一的离线自进化框架中分析四种代表性策略，包括单轮验证、带反馈的多轮修订、迭代训练和课程学习。

sentences.en: Our primary experiments use Knights and Knaves (KK) logical reasoning tasks, which provide deterministic solutions, controlled difficulty levels, and a clean testbed for easy-to-hard generalization.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要实验使用骑士与无赖（KK）逻辑推理任务，该任务提供确定性解决方案、受控难度级别，以及一个干净的易到难泛化测试平台。

sentences.en: We first show that SE consistently improves over the base model, but plateaus after excessive training compute is invested, and eventually still leaves a non trivial gap to oracle supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们首先表明，SE一致地优于基座模型，但在投入过多训练算力后趋于平稳，最终仍与神谕监督存在非平凡差距。

sentences.en: We find that multi-turn critic-revision with large models could reach strong self-evolution performance, where Gemma 12B nearly matches oracle-supervised training.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，使用大模型进行多轮评论家-修订能达到强大的自进化表现，其中Gemma 12B几乎匹配神谕监督训练。

sentences.en: Beyond KK, we also evaluate SE on real-world reasoning benchmarks, where gains are also modest.
sentences.zh: 除KK之外，我们还在真实世界的推理基准上评估SE，其收益同样有限。

sentences.en: Overall, our results characterize when closed-loop SE can help, and show how internally generated supervision remains insufficient under this minimal formulation.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果刻画了闭环SE何时能发挥作用，并表明在这种最小化设定下，内部生成的监督仍然不足。

title_en: On the Generalization in Topology Optimization via Sensitivity-Conditioned Bernoulli Flow Matching
title_zh: 论灵敏度条件下的伯努利流匹配在拓扑优化中的泛化

sentences.en: Surrogate models for topology optimization (TO) exhibit highly variable out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization under distribution shifts such as changing loads or boundary conditions, yet the source of this variability remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 拓扑优化（TO）的代理模型在载荷或边界条件等分布偏移下表现出高度可变的分布外（OOD）泛化，但这种可变性的来源仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that OOD performance is governed by how much information the conditioning signal preserves about the adjoint sensitivity (reduced gradient) that drives classical TO.
sentences.zh: 我们假设OOD性能由条件信号对驱动经典TO的伴随灵敏度（简化梯度）所保留的信息量决定。

sentences.en: Modeling the TO pipeline as a causal Markov chain, the Data Processing Inequality establishes that, under this abstraction, the sensitivity field is an information-theoretically optimal conditioning signal for topology prediction.
sentences.zh: 将TO流程建模为因果马尔可夫链后，数据处理不等式表明，在这一抽象下，灵敏度场是拓扑预测中信息论意义上最优的条件信号。

sentences.en: However, computing exact adjoint sensitivities can be expensive or unavailable in practice; we observe that certain physical fields can approximate sensitivities through monotone transformations.
sentences.zh: 然而，计算精确的伴随灵敏度在实践中可能代价高昂或不可用；我们观察到某些物理场可以通过单调变换逼近灵敏度。

sentences.en: To formalize this, we introduce \textbf{pseudo-sensitivities} to characterize which fields enable generalization versus those that are information-poor.
sentences.zh: 为形式化这一点，我们引入\textbf{伪灵敏度}来刻画哪些场能够实现泛化，哪些场信息贫乏。

sentences.en: We then show that a sensitivity-conditioned Bernoulli flow-matching generator empirically confirms these predictions: conditioning on sensitivities yields state-of-the-art OOD performance, while increasingly distant physical fields degrade toward raw parameter conditioning.
sentences.zh: 然后我们表明，灵敏度条件下的伯努利流匹配生成器在实证上证实了这些预测：以灵敏度为条件可获得最先进的OOD性能，而日益偏离的物理场则退化到原始参数条件化的水平。

sentences.en: Results hold across structural TO benchmarks under load shifts and our new CFD-TO dataset under boundary-condition shifts such as multi-outlet configurations.
sentences.zh: 结果在载荷偏移下的结构TO基准以及多出口配置等边界条件偏移下的新CFD-TO数据集上均成立。

sentences.en: Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/tum-pbs/topotransformer.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/tum-pbs/topotransformer 获取。

authors.name: Duarte Filipe Valoroso Madeira
authors.institution: Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH) | BMW Group

title_en: On the Identifiability of Poisson Branching Structural Causal Model Under Latent Confounding
title_zh: 论潜在混杂下泊松分支结构因果模型的可识别性

sentences.en: Causal discovery from observational count data poses unique challenges, particularly when the data exhibit inherent branching structures, e.g., an upstream event (e.g., an ad impression) triggers a downstream event (e.g., a purchase) with a certain probability.
sentences.zh: 从观测计数数据中进行因果发现提出了独特的挑战，特别是当数据表现出固有的分支结构时，例如上游事件（如广告展示）以一定概率触发下游事件（如购买）。

sentences.en: Such branching dynamics are naturally captured by thinning operators (for the branching structure) and an independent Poisson distribution (for exogenous noise), constituting the Poisson Branching Structural Causal Model (PB-SCM).
sentences.zh: 这种分支动力学自然地由稀疏化算子（用于分支结构）和独立泊松分布（用于外生噪声）来刻画，构成了泊松分支结构因果模型（PB-SCM）。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches based on PB-SCM rely on the restrictive assumption of causal sufficiency, failing to account for ubiquitous latent confounders that can bias estimation.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于PB-SCM的现有方法依赖因果充分性这一限制性假设，未能考虑可能使估计产生偏差的普遍存在的潜在混杂因素。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose the Latent Confounding Poisson Branching Structural Causal Model (LC-PB-SCM) to bridge this gap.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出潜在混杂泊松分支结构因果模型（LC-PB-SCM）来弥补这一差距。

sentences.en: We leverage Probability Generating Functions (PGFs) to characterize the complex dependencies introduced by latent confounding.
sentences.zh: 我们利用概率生成函数（PGFs）来刻画由潜在混杂引入的复杂依赖关系。

sentences.en: Then, we establish a Trie representation theorem that maps the branching causal mechanisms to the algebraic properties of PGF monomials.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们建立了一个Trie表示定理，将分支因果机制映射到PGF单项式的代数性质上。

sentences.en: Based on local PGFs, we establish a complete identifiability condition for local 3-variables that covers all causal patterns distinguishable up to monomial equivalence.
sentences.zh: 基于局部PGF，我们为局部三变量建立了完整的可识别性条件，覆盖了在单项式等价意义下所有可区分的因果模式。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose a practical algorithm to learn causal structures under latent confounding and demonstrate its effectiveness through experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出一种实用的算法来学习潜在混杂下的因果结构，并通过合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验展示了其有效性。

title_en: On the Infinite Width and Depth Limits of Predictive Coding Networks
title_zh: 论预测编码网络的无限宽与无限深极限

sentences.en: Predictive coding (PC) is a biologically plausible alternative to standard backpropagation (BP) that minimises an energy function with respect to network activities before updating weights.
sentences.zh: 预测编码（PC）是标准反向传播（BP）的一种具有生物学合理性的替代方案，它先在更新权重之前相对于网络活动最小化一个能量函数。

sentences.en: Recent work has improved the training stability of deep PC networks (PCNs) by leveraging some BP-inspired reparameterisations.
sentences.zh: 近期工作通过利用一些受BP启发的重新参数化技术，提升了深度PC网络（PCNs）的训练稳定性。

sentences.en: However, the full scalability and theoretical basis of these methods remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法的完整可扩展性和理论基础仍不清楚。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we study the infinite width and depth limits of PCNs.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们研究PCNs的无限宽与无限深极限。

sentences.en: For linear residual networks, we show that the set of width- and depth-stable feature-learning parameterisations for PC is exactly the same as for BP.
sentences.zh: 对于线性残差网络，我们证明PC的宽度和深度稳定特征学习参数化集合与BP完全相同。

sentences.en: Moreover, under any of these parameterisations, the PC energy with equilibrated activities converges to the quadratic BP loss when the model width is much larger than the depth, resulting in PC computing the same gradients as BP.
sentences.zh: 此外，在这些参数化中的任何一种之下，当模型宽度远大于深度时，具有平衡活动的PC能量会收敛到二次BP损失，从而使PC计算与BP相同的梯度。

sentences.en: Experiments show that, as long as an activity equilibrium is reached, convergence to BP holds for nonlinear models including convolutional networks and transformers.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，只要达到活动平衡，对于包括卷积网络和transformer在内的非线性模型，向BP的收敛都成立。

sentences.en: Overall, this work constrains the types of parameterisation that are scalable with PC, while showing a way in which BP can be effectively implemented with only local updates in much wider than deep networks like the brain.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这项工作约束了能与PC一起扩展的参数化类型，同时展示了一种在远宽于深的网络（如大脑）中仅用局部更新就能有效实现BP的方式。

authors.name: El Mehdi Achour
authors.institution: University Mohammed VI Polytechnic (UM6P College of Computing)

title_en: On the Interaction of Batch Noise, Adaptivity, and Compression, under $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness: An SDE Approach
title_zh: 论 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑性下批噪声、自适应与压缩的相互作用：一种SDE方法

sentences.en: Distributed stochastic optimization intertwines (i) stochastic gradient noise, (ii) communication compression, and (iii) adaptive/normalized updates.
sentences.zh: 分布式随机优化将（i）随机梯度噪声，（ii）通信压缩，（iii）自适应/归一化更新交织在一起。

sentences.en: While each factor has been studied in isolation, their joint effect under realistic assumptions remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然每个因素都已被单独研究，但在现实假设下它们的联合效应仍未被充分理解。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a unified theoretical framework for Distributed Compressed SGD (DCSGD) and its sign variant Distributed SignSGD (DSignSGD) under the recently introduced $(L_0, L_1)$-smoothness condition.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们在新提出的 $(L_0, L_1)$-光滑性条件下，为分布式压缩SGD（DCSGD）及其符号变体分布式SignSGD（DSignSGD）建立了一个统一的理论框架。

sentences.en: From a conceptual perspective, we show that the first- and second-order modified equations from the literature do not accurately model the discrete-time step-size/stability restrictions, especially under $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness.
sentences.zh: 从概念角度看，我们表明文献中的一阶和二阶修正方程无法准确建模离散时间的步长/稳定性限制，尤其是在 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑性下。

sentences.en: From a technical perspective, we propose new first-order SDEs by carefully incorporating curvature-dependent terms into their drift: This helps capture the fine-grained relationship between learning rate restrictions, gradient noise, compression, and the geometry of the loss landscape.
sentences.zh: 从技术角度看，我们通过在其漂移项中仔细纳入曲率相关项，提出了新的一阶SDE：这有助于捕捉学习率限制、梯度噪声、压缩与损失景观几何之间的细粒度关系。

sentences.en: Importantly, we do so under general gradient noise assumptions, including heavy-tailed and affine-variance regimes, which extend beyond the classical bounded-variance setting.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我们是在包括重尾和仿射方差情形的通用梯度噪声假设下进行这一工作的，超出了经典有界方差设定的范畴。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that normalizing the updates of DCSGD emerges as a natural condition for stability, with the degree of normalization precisely determined by the gradient noise structure, the landscape’s regularity, and the compression rate.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，对DCSGD的更新进行归一化会成为稳定性的一种自然条件，其归一化程度精确地由梯度噪声结构、景观的规则性和压缩率决定。

sentences.en: In contrast, DSignSGD converges even under heavy-tailed noise with standard learning rate schedules.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，即使使用标准学习率调度，DSignSGD在重尾噪声下也能收敛。

sentences.en: Together, these findings offer both new theoretical insights and perspectives, and practical guidance.
sentences.zh: 这些发现既提供了新的理论洞见和视角，也提供了实用指导。

authors.name: Antonio Orvieto
authors.institution: ELLIS Institute Tübingen, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen AI Center, Tübingen, Germany

authors.name: Eduard Gorbunov
authors.institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

title_en: On the Interplay of Pre-Training, Mid-Training, and RL on Reasoning Language Models
title_zh: 论预训练、中训练与RL在推理语言模型中的相互作用

sentences.en: Recent reinforcement learning (RL) techniques have yielded impressive reasoning improvements in language models, yet it remains unclear whether post-training truly extends a model’s reasoning ability beyond what it acquires during pre-training.
sentences.zh: 近期强化学习（RL）技术在语言模型推理上带来了令人印象深刻的改善，但仍不清楚后训练是否真正扩展了模型超出其在预训练期间获得的推理能力。

sentences.en: A central challenge is the lack of control in modern training pipelines: large-scale pre-training corpora are opaque, mid-training is often underexamined, and RL objectives interact with unknown prior knowledge in complex ways.
sentences.zh: 一个核心挑战是现代训练流程缺乏控制：大规模预训练语料不透明，中训练往往缺乏研究，而RL目标以复杂方式与未知的先验知识相互作用。

sentences.en: To resolve this ambiguity, we develop a fully controlled experimental framework that isolates the causal contributions of pre-training, mid-training, and RL-based post-training.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一模糊性，我们开发了一个完全受控的实验框架，将预训练、中训练和基于RL的后训练的因果贡献分离开来。

sentences.en: Our approach employs synthetic reasoning tasks with explicit atomic operations, parseable step-by-step reasoning traces, and systematic manipulation of training distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法采用具有显式原子操作、可解析的逐步推理轨迹以及训练分布系统化操纵的合成推理任务。

sentences.en: We evaluate models along two axes: extrapolative generalization to more complex compositions and contextual generalization across surface contexts.
sentences.zh: 我们沿两个轴评估模型：对更复杂组合的外推泛化，以及跨表面情境的情境泛化。

sentences.en: Using this framework, we reconcile competing views on RL’s effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 利用这一框架，我们调和了关于RL有效性的相互竞争的观点。

sentences.en: We show that: 1) RL produces true capability gains (pass@128) only when pre-training leaves sufficient headroom and when RL data target the model’s edge of competence, tasks at the boundary that are difficult but not yet out of reach.
sentences.zh: 我们表明：1）只有当预训练留有足够余地，且RL数据以模型的能力边缘为目标（即处于边界上、困难但并非遥不可及的任务）时，RL才会产生真正的能力增益（pass@128）。

sentences.en: 2) Contextual generalization requires minimal yet sufficient pre-training exposure, after which RL can reliably transfer.
sentences.zh: 2）情境泛化需要最少但充分的预训练暴露，之后RL能够可靠地迁移。

sentences.en: 3) Mid-training significantly enhances performance under fixed compute compared with RL only, demonstrating its central but underexplored role in training pipelines.
sentences.zh: 3）与仅使用RL相比，中训练在固定计算下显著提升了性能，展示了其在训练流程中核心但未充分探索的作用。

sentences.en: 4) Process-level rewards reduce reward hacking and improve reasoning fidelity.
sentences.zh: 4）过程级奖励减少了奖励黑客行为，并提高了推理忠实度。

sentences.en: Together, these results clarify the interplay between pre-training, mid-training, and RL, offering a foundation for understanding and improving reasoning LM training strategies.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同阐明了预训练、中训练与RL之间的相互作用，为理解和改进推理LM训练策略奠定了基础。

title_en: On the Intrinsic Limits of Transformer Image Embeddings in Non-Solvable Spatial Reasoning
title_zh: 论Transformer图像嵌入在不可解空间推理中的内在局限

sentences.en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) excel in semantic recognition but exhibit systematic failures in spatial reasoning tasks such as mental rotation.
sentences.zh: 视觉Transformer（ViTs）在语义识别上表现卓越，但在心理旋转等空间推理任务中表现出系统性失败。

sentences.en: While often attributed to data scale, this work argues that the limitation arises from the intrinsic circuit complexity of the architecture.
sentences.zh: 虽然这常被归因于数据规模，但本工作认为该局限源于架构固有的电路复杂度。

sentences.en: By formalizing spatial understanding as a **Group Homomorphism Problem**—where latent embeddings preserve the algebraic structure of physical transformations acting on images—we identify a fundamental computational bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 通过将空间理解形式化为**群同态问题**——其中潜在嵌入保持作用于图像上的物理变换的代数结构——我们识别出一个根本的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: Specifically, for non-solvable groups (e.g., $\mathrm{SO}(3)$), maintaining such structure-preserving embeddings is lower-bounded by the Word Problem, which is $\mathsf{NC^1}$-complete.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，对于不可解群（如 $\mathrm{SO}(3)$），保持这种结构保持嵌入受单词问题下界约束，而单词问题是 $\mathsf{NC^1}$-完全的。

sentences.en: In contrast, constant-depth ViTs with polynomial precision are strictly bounded by the complexity class $\mathsf{TC^0}$.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，具有多项式精度的恒定深度ViT严格受限于复杂度类 $\mathsf{TC^0}$。

sentences.en: Under the standard conjecture $\mathsf{TC^0} \subsetneq \mathsf{NC^1}$, a **complexity boundary** emerges: constant-depth architectures lack the logical depth required to capture non-solvable spatial structures in a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 在标准猜想 $\mathsf{TC^0} \subsetneq \mathsf{NC^1}$ 下，出现了**复杂度边界**：恒定深度架构缺乏在单次前向传播中捕获不可解空间结构所需的逻辑深度。

sentences.en: To empirically validate this theoretical gap, we propose the **Latent Space Algebra (LSA)** benchmark, which reveals a significant degradation in ViT representations as the compositional depth of non-solvable tasks increases.
sentences.zh: 为实证验证这一理论差距，我们提出了**潜在空间代数（LSA）**基准，它揭示了随着不可解任务组合深度的增加，ViT表示会出现显著退化。

title_en: On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective
title_zh: 论测试时自适应的可学习性：一种恢复复杂度视角

sentences.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) aims to adapt models to maintain reliable performance on non-stationary test streams without requiring labeled data.
sentences.zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）旨在使模型在非平稳测试流上保持可靠性能，而无需标注数据。

sentences.en: Despite its empirical success, the learnability of TTA under non-stationary streams remains unexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管其经验上取得了成功，但在非平稳流下TTA的可学习性仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: A key challenge is the lack of a principled theoretical framework that simultaneously aligns with the TTA objective and captures both continuously evolving distribution shifts and intrinsic information constraints.
sentences.zh: 一个关键挑战是缺乏一个同时贴合TTA目标、又能捕捉持续演变的分布偏移和内在信息约束的原则性理论框架。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose the first theoretical framework for studying the learnability of TTA and introduce $(\epsilon,\delta)$-Recovery Complexity and $(\epsilon,\rho)$-TTA Learnability.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了研究TTA可学习性的第一个理论框架，并引入了 $(ε,δ)$-恢复复杂度和 $(ε,ρ)$-TTA可学习性。

sentences.en: Recovery complexity measures the post-shift time needed to maintain excess risk below a target level with high probability, and is further extended to TTA learnability, which measures the long-term reliability of TTA.
sentences.zh: 恢复复杂度衡量偏移后以高概率将超额风险保持在目标水平以下所需的时间，并进一步扩展到衡量TTA长期可靠性的TTA可学习性。

sentences.en: Within this framework, we introduce a novel discrete surrogate for non-stationary test streams, enabling a unified and tractable analysis of both gradual and abrupt shifts.
sentences.zh: 在此框架内，我们为非平稳测试流引入了一种新颖的离散替代，使渐变的和突变的偏移都能得到统一且易处理的分析。

sentences.en: We derive order-wise matching lower and upper bounds on recovery complexity, revealing fundamental limits of TTA and an intrinsic adaptivity-information trade-off.
sentences.zh: 我们推导了恢复复杂度的阶匹配下界和上界，揭示了TTA的根本局限以及内在的自适应-信息权衡。

sentences.en: These results provide unified learnability guarantees for TTA that complement regret-based analyses.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为TTA提供了统一的可学习性保证，补充了基于遗憾的分析。

title_en: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of LLM Pre-Training on Annotation Task Performance
title_zh: 论LLM适应性的极限：LLM预训练对标注任务性能的影响

sentences.en: Pre-trained Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for zero-shot annotation and LLM-as-a-judge tasks, yet their reliability hinges on how pre-trained priors interact with user-provided instructions.
sentences.zh: 预训练大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于零样本标注和LLM-as-a-judge任务，然而它们的可靠性取决于预训练先验与用户提供指令之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: We investigate three dimensions of this interaction: (1) how an LLM’s familiarity with data and task definitions affects performance, (2) the extent to which additional information in prompts can correct zero-shot errors (“decision stickiness”), and (3) model susceptibility to misaligned task definitions.
sentences.zh: 我们考察这一交互的三个维度：（1）LLM对数据和任务定义的熟悉程度如何影响性能，（2）提示中的额外信息在多大程度上能纠正零样本错误（（“决策粘性”）），以及（3）模型对错位任务定义的敏感性。

sentences.en: Through experiments on toxicity detection across diverse datasets (spanning social media, gaming, news, and forums) using both dense and mixture-of-experts models, we find that nearly two-thirds of zero-shot errors are resistant to correction, with an overall rescue rate (fraction of initial errors corrected by prompting) of only 36.4%.
sentences.zh: 通过在多个数据集（涵盖社交媒体、游戏、新闻和论坛）上使用稠密模型和专家混合模型进行毒性检测实验，我们发现近三分之二的零样本错误对纠正具有抵抗力，总体挽救率（通过提示纠正的初始错误比例）仅为36.4%。

sentences.en: High-confidence errors prove especially resistant to correction.
sentences.zh: 高置信度错误尤其难以纠正。

sentences.en: When given misaligned definitions, LLMs follow them while maintaining confidence levels unchanged from the aligned condition.
sentences.zh: 当给定错位的定义时，LLM会遵循这些定义，同时保持与对齐条件相同水平的置信度。

sentences.en: Crucially, we introduce Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF), a metric measuring alignment between a model’s internal concept and the task definition.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们引入了定义特定熟悉度（DSF），一种衡量模型内部概念与任务定义之间对齐程度的指标。

sentences.en: After controlling for dataset-level confounds, DSF shows positive association with model performance (partial r = +0.34), while text memorization as measured by ROUGE-L shows no positive association (partial r = −0.19).
sentences.zh: 在控制数据集层面的混杂因素后，DSF与模型性能呈正相关（部分r = +0.34），而以ROUGE-L衡量的文本记忆则没有正相关（部分r = −0.19）。

sentences.en: Overall, these findings suggest clear limits on prompt-based correction in annotation tasks and underscore the importance of definition alignment over text-level memorization.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些发现表明标注任务中基于提示的纠正存在明确极限，并强调了定义对齐优于文本级记忆的重要性。

title_en: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
title_zh: 论LLM适应性的极限：模型内化先验对标注任务性能的影响

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for zero-shot annotation and LLM-as-a-judge tasks, yet their reliability hinges on how model-internalized priors interact with user-provided instructions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于零样本标注和LLM-as-a-judge任务，然而它们的可靠性取决于模型内化先验与用户所提供指令之间的相互作用。

sentences.en: We investigate three dimensions of this interaction: (1) how an LLM's familiarity with data and task definitions affects performance, (2) the extent to which additional information in prompts can correct zero-shot errors (``decision stickiness''), and (3) model susceptibility to misaligned task definitions.
sentences.zh: 我们考察这一交互的三个维度：（1）LLM对数据与任务定义的熟悉程度如何影响性能，（2）提示中的额外信息在多大程度上能纠正零样本错误（“决策粘性”），以及（3）模型对错位任务定义的敏感性。

sentences.en: Through experiments on toxicity detection across diverse datasets (spanning social media, gaming, news, and forums) using both dense and mixture-of-experts models, we find that nearly two-thirds of zero-shot errors are resistant to correction, with an overall rescue rate (fraction of initial errors corrected by prompting) of only 34.8\%.
sentences.zh: 通过在多个数据集（涵盖社交媒体、游戏、新闻和论坛）上使用稠密模型和专家混合模型进行毒性检测实验，我们发现近三分之二的零样本错误对纠正具有抵抗力，总体挽救率仅为34.8\%。

sentences.en: High-confidence errors prove especially resistant to correction.
sentences.zh: 高置信度错误尤其难以纠正。

sentences.en: When given misaligned definitions, LLMs follow them while maintaining confidence levels unchanged from the aligned condition.
sentences.zh: 当给定错位的定义时，LLM会遵循这些定义，同时保持与对齐条件相同水平的置信度。

sentences.en: Crucially, we introduce Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF), which measures alignment between a model's internal concept and the task definition.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们引入了定义特定熟悉度（DSF），它衡量模型内部概念与任务定义之间的对齐程度。

sentences.en: After controlling for dataset-level confounds, DSF shows a positive association with model performance (partial $r=+0.41$), while three distinct memorization metrics (ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and embedding cosine similarity) all fail to show a positive association.
sentences.zh: 在控制数据集层面混杂因素后，DSF与模型性能呈正相关（部分 $r=+0.41$），而三种不同的记忆指标（ROUGE-L、BERTScore和嵌入余弦相似度）都未能显示正相关。

sentences.en: These findings show the limitations of prompt-based correction in annotation tasks, highlighting the importance of definition alignment over text-level memorization.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明标注任务中基于提示的纠正存在局限，凸显了定义对齐相对于文本级记忆的重要性。

title_en: On the Limits of Test-Time Compute: Sequential Reward Filtering for Better Inference
title_zh: 论测试时计算的极限：用于更好推理的序列奖励过滤

sentences.en: Test-time compute (TTC) has become an increasingly prominent paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 测试时计算（TTC）已成为增强大语言模型（LLMs）的一种日益突出的范式。

sentences.en: Despite the empirical success of methods such as best-of-$n$ (BoN) sampling and sequential revision, their fundamental limits remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 尽管诸如best-of-$n$（BoN）采样和序列修订等方法在经验上取得了成功，但它们的基本极限仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We address this gap by analyzing a mixture-of-reference policy model and proving that standard BoN is inherently suboptimal.
sentences.zh: 我们通过分析一种混合参照策略模型来弥补这一空白，并证明标准BoN本质上是次优的。

sentences.en: To move closer to the optimal frontier, we study reward-filtered sequential inference, a simple procedure that selectively incorporates only high-reward generations into the context.
sentences.zh: 为更接近最优前沿，我们研究了奖励过滤的序列推理，这是一种简单过程，选择性地仅将高奖励生成纳入上下文。

sentences.en: This mechanism concentrates computation on superior policy candidates and suppresses inferior ones.
sentences.zh: 该机制将计算集中于更优秀的策略候选，并抑制较差的候选。

sentences.en: On the theoretical side, we show that reward-filtered sequential inference yields strictly stronger guarantees than standard TTC paradigms.
sentences.zh: 在理论方面，我们表明奖励过滤的序列推理能产生比标准TTC范式严格更强的保证。

sentences.en: On the empirical side, we evaluate such an inference strategy across diverse benchmarks and observe consistent improvements over widely used approaches, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of our framework.
sentences.zh: 在实证方面，我们在多个基准上评估了这种推理策略，并观察到相比广泛使用的方法持续改进，展示了我们框架的实际有效性。

title_en: On the Optimization Trajectory of DeepWalk Embeddings
title_zh: 论DeepWalk嵌入的优化轨迹

sentences.en: The DeepWalk algorithm has been widely used for learning node embeddings in graphs.
sentences.zh: DeepWalk算法已被广泛用于学习图中的节点嵌入。

sentences.en: Combined with the idea of _negative sampling_, the DeepWalk algorithm has been shown to be implementable at scale, easily handling graphs with millions of nodes.
sentences.zh: 结合_负采样_的思想，DeepWalk算法已被证明可以大规模实现，轻松处理具有数百万节点的图。

sentences.en: However, theoretical guarantees on the resulting embeddings are much less understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，对由此产生的嵌入的理论保证却远未被充分理解。

sentences.en: Recent results have studied the minimizers of the objective and have shown interesting guarantees for certain graph classes.
sentences.zh: 近期结果研究了目标的最小化器，并对某些图类给出了有趣的保证。

sentences.en: However, the optimization _trajectory_, i.e., what happens when we start at a random initialization and run gradient descent, remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，优化的_轨迹_，即当我们从随机初始化出发运行梯度下降时会发生什么，仍远未被理解。

sentences.en: This is especially true for the implementation of DeepWalk using Skip-gram with negative sampling (SGNS), since the variance of the stochastic updates turns out to be very large.
sentences.zh: 对于使用带负采样的Skip-gram（SGNS）实现DeepWalk尤其如此，因为随机更新的方差非常大。

sentences.en: In this work, we make progress on this question.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们在这一问题上取得了进展。

sentences.en: We show that for "small norm" initialization, under a spectral gap assumption on the graph, the DeepWalk embeddings align with the column space of a fixed low-rank matrix.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对于“小范数”初始化，在图的谱间隙假设下，DeepWalk嵌入与一个固定低秩矩阵的列空间对齐。

sentences.en: For graphs generated from Stochastic Block Models with certain separation conditions, our results imply that the DeepWalk embeddings recover cluster structure.
sentences.zh: 对于在满足一定分离条件的随机块模型上生成的图，我们的结果意味着DeepWalk嵌入能够恢复簇结构。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, our results give the first analysis of the optimization trajectory of DeepWalk with negative sampling on non-trivial graph classes.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，我们的结果首次对非平凡图类上带负采样的DeepWalk的优化轨迹进行了分析。

title_en: On the origin of neural scaling laws:  from random graphs to natural language
title_zh: 论神经标度律的起源：从随机图到自然语言

sentences.en: Scaling laws have played a major role in modern AI, providing predictive power over how model performance will improve with increasing resources.
sentences.zh: 标度律在现代AI中发挥了重要作用，为模型性能如何随资源增加而提升提供了预测能力。

sentences.en: This has spurred intense interest in their origin, with a common suggestion being that they arise from power laws already present in the data.
sentences.zh: 这激发了人们对其起源的浓厚兴趣，一种常见观点认为它们源于数据中已经存在的幂律。

sentences.en: Here we study scaling laws for transformers trained to predict random walks on graphs with tunable complexity.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们研究在复杂度可调的图上训练的、用于预测随机游走的transformer的标度律。

sentences.en: We show that this simplified setting already yields scaling laws even in the absence of power laws in the data correlations.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，即使数据相关性中不存在幂律，这一简化设定也已能产生标度律。

sentences.en: We further consider dialing down the complexity of language by training on sequences sampled from increasingly simplified generative language models, from 4,2,1-layer transformer language models down to language bigrams, revealing a monotonic evolution of the scaling exponents.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步考虑降低语言的复杂度，通过在越来越简化的生成式语言模型（从4、2、1层transformer语言模型一路简化到语言二元组）采样的序列上训练，揭示了标度指数的一致演化。

sentences.en: Our results also include scaling laws obtained from training on random walks on random graphs drawn from Erdös-Renyi and scale-free Barabási-Albert ensembles.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果还包括在从Erdös-Renyi和无标度Barabási-Albert系综抽取的随机图之随机游走上训练所获得的标度律。

sentences.en: Finally, we revisit scaling laws for language modeling, demonstrating that several essential results can be reproduced using 2 layer transformers with context length of 100, demonstrate an alternative method for obtaining compute optimal curves, and provide preliminary evidence that maximal update parameterization may be more parameter efficient than standard parameterization.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们重新审视语言建模的标度律，证明若干关键结果可以用上下文长度为100的2层transformer复现，展示了一种获得计算最优曲线的替代方法，并提供初步证据表明最大更新参数化可能比标准参数化更具参数效率。

title_en: On the Plasticity and Stability for Post-Training Large Language Models
title_zh: 论大语言模型后训练的塑性与稳定性

sentences.en: Training stability remains a critical bottleneck for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), often manifesting as a trade-off between reasoning plasticity and general capability retention.
sentences.zh: 训练稳定性仍是分组相对策略优化（GRPO）的关键瓶颈，通常表现为推理可塑性与通用能力保持之间的权衡。

sentences.en: We identify a root cause as the geometric conflict between plasticity and stability gradients, which leads to destructive interference.
sentences.zh: 我们将根因识别为可塑性与稳定性梯度之间的几何冲突，它会导致破坏性干扰。

sentences.en: Crucially, we argue that deterministic projection methods are suboptimal for GRPO as they overlook the intrinsic stochasticity of group-based gradient estimates.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们认为确定性投影方法对GRPO而言是次优的，因为它们忽视了基于组的梯度估计的内在随机性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Probabilistic Conflict Resolution (PCR), a Bayesian framework that models gradients as random variables.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们提出概率冲突消解（PCR），一种将梯度建模为随机变量的贝叶斯框架。

sentences.en: PCR dynamically arbitrates conflicts via an uncertainty-aware ``soft projection'' mechanism, optimizing the signal-to-noise ratio.
sentences.zh: PCR通过一种不确定性感知的“软投影”机制动态仲裁冲突，优化信噪比。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that PCR significantly smooths the training trajectory and achieves superior performance in various reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，PCR能显著平滑训练轨迹，并在多种推理任务上取得优越性能。

title_en: On the Power of (Approximate) Reward Models for Inference-Time Scaling: Sequential Monte Carlo and Beyond
title_zh: 论（近似）奖励模型对推理时缩放的能力：序贯蒙特卡洛及其超越

sentences.en: Inference-time scaling has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capability of large language models.
sentences.zh: 推理时缩放最近已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的强大范式。

sentences.en: Among various approaches, \emph{Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC)} has become a particularly important framework, enabling iterative generation, evaluation, rejection, and resampling of intermediate reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: 在各种方法中，\emph{序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）}已成为一个特别重要的框架，它实现了中间推理轨迹的迭代生成、评估、拒绝和重采样。

sentences.en: A central component in this process is the \emph{reward model}, which evaluates partial solutions and guides the allocation of computation during inference.
sentences.zh: 该过程的一个核心组件是\emph{奖励模型}，它在推理期间评估部分解并指导计算的分配。

sentences.en: However, in practice, true reward models are never available.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，真正的奖励模型从来不可用。

sentences.en: All deployed systems rely on \emph{approximate reward models}, raising a fundamental question: \emph{Why and when do approximate reward models suffice for effective inference-time scaling?}
sentences.zh: 所有已部署的系统都依赖\emph{近似奖励模型}，这就提出了一个根本问题：\emph{为什么以及何时近似奖励模型足以实现有效的推理时缩放？}

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a theoretical answer.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们给出了理论回答。

sentences.en: We identify the \emph{Bellman error} of the approximate reward model as the key quantity governing the effectiveness of SMC-based inference-time scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们将近似奖励模型的\emph{Bellman误差}确定为支配基于SMC的推理时缩放有效性的关键量。

sentences.en: For a reasoning process of length $T$, we show that if the Bellman error of the approximate reward model is bounded by $O(1/T)$, then combining this reward model with SMC reduces the computational complexity of reasoning from exponential in $T$ to polynomial in $T$.
sentences.zh: 对于长度为 $T$ 的推理过程，我们表明如果近似奖励模型的Bellman误差以 $O(1/T)$ 为界，那么将该奖励模型与SMC结合能将推理的计算复杂度从关于 $T$ 的指数级降至多项式级。

sentences.en: This yields an \emph{exponential improvement} in inference efficiency despite using only approximate rewards.
sentences.zh: 尽管仅使用近似奖励，这也会带来推理效率的\emph{指数级提升}。

title_en: On the Power of Source Screening for Learning Shared Feature Extractors
title_zh: 论源筛选在学习共享特征提取器中的作用

sentences.en: Learning with shared representation is widely recognized as an effective way to separate commonalities from heterogeneity across various heterogeneous sources.
sentences.zh: 使用共享表示学习被广泛认为是将各种异构源之间的共性与异质性分离开来的有效方式。

sentences.en: Most existing work includes all related data sources via simultaneously training a common feature extractor and source-specific heads.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有工作通过同时训练一个通用特征提取器和各源专用的输出头，纳入所有相关数据源。

sentences.en: It is well understood that data sources with low relevance or poor quality may hinder representation learning.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，相关性低或质量差的数据源可能妨碍表示学习。

sentences.en: In this paper, we further dive into the question of which data sources should be learned jointly by focusing on the traditionally deemed "good" collection of sources, in which individual sources have similar relevance and qualities with respect to the true underlying common structure.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们进一步深入探讨哪些数据源应当被联合学习这一问题，聚焦于传统上被视为“好”的源集合，其中各个源相对于真实底层公共结构具有相似的相关性和质量。

sentences.en: Towards tractability, we focus on the linear setting where sources share a low-dimensional subspace.
sentences.zh: 为便于处理，我们聚焦于线性设定，其中各源共享一个低维子空间。

sentences.en: We find that source screening can play a central role in statistically optimal subspace estimation.
sentences.zh: 我们发现源筛选在统计最优的子空间估计中可以发挥核心作用。

sentences.en: We show that, for a broad class of problem instances, training on a carefully selected subset of sources suffices to achieve minimax optimality, even when a substantial portion of data is discarded.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对一大类问题实例而言，即使丢弃了大量数据，在精心选择的源子集上训练也足以达到极小极大最优性。

sentences.en: We formalize the notion of an informative subpopulation, develop algorithms and practical heuristics for identifying such subsets, and validate their effectiveness through both theoretical analysis and empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化了信息丰富子群体的概念，开发了识别此类子集的算法和实用启发式方法，并通过理论分析和合成及真实数据集上的实证评估验证了它们的有效性。
